'di dbang dus su grol ba dang mi mtshungs te/ dbang dus su rgyu rkyen nus pa kun tshang ba'i phyir/ zhes dpe dang bcas bkod mod/ phyogs re zhes pa cha shas kyi don du tha snyad la grags pa ltar/ dbang*/ bskyed rim/ rdzogs rim sogs cha shas re re la 'dod dgos pa 'dra ste/ rgyu mtshan/ ye shes skye ba'i sna 'dren thams cad smin byed dbang gis byed dgos so// des mi byed na/ dbang ma thob par bskyed rdzogs bsgom du mi rung la/ dbang gis sna 'dren byas zin nas/ da gzod gtum mo lta bu'i ye shes skye ba'i sna 'dren bya rgyu gar yod/ yi ga 'byed pa'i zas de yang lus brtas nus kyi zas cig ka yin grang*/ mthong lam skye ba la kho rang skye ba'i rgyu rkyen nus pa kun tshang dgos pa mad kyang*/ gtum mo lta bu'i rdzogs rim gcig gi steng du mthong lam skye ba'i rgyu rkyen nus pa kun ma tshang bar sgrub su zhig gis spobs/ rdo rje theg pa'i sgor zhugs nas// dbang bskur las gzhan chos med do// zhes gsung bzhin du/ de khyad du bsad nas/ 'di dbang dus grol ba dang mi mtshungs te/ zhes bskyed rdzogs kyi cha re re bzhin dbang las logs su bkar ba ni rang la gnod pa'i thabs gshom pa'o// mkhas dbang dges dgur 'dzum pa'i zla ris kyis// rgyal bstan kunda'i 'dab rgya grol ma thag /phyogs dus kun tu 'thul ba legs bshad kyi// bsung zhim bdud rtsi'i do shal tshar du dngar// 'jam mgon zhal sgor rgyu ba'i bcud bda' ba// rnam dpyod mgrin par sim kyang ma tshim de// 'jig rten dbang phyug gsung rab lces myang ba'i// klu sgrub klu dbang mkhas pa de bsngags so// zhes pa ni bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa'o// // rgyal ba'i gan mdzod chen po las/ nā ro dang ni mai tri pa'i// phyag rgya chen po gang yin pa// de ni las dang chos dang ni// dam tshig dang ni phyag rgya che// gsang sngags rgyud las ji skad du// bshad pa de nyid khong bzhed do// jo bo gnyis kyi lung ma mthong bar/

de skad zer yod snyam nas sbyar ba kho na te/ nā ro pa'i dgyes rdor 'grel chen dang*/ bsre 'pho'i man ngag gnyis ka mthun par/ las dang chos dang phyag rgya che// dam tshig ces bya 'od gsal nyid// ces bshad pa dang*/ mai tri pa'i phyag rgya bzhi bshad pa'i gzhung dbang bskur nges bstan yin la/ der/ las kyi phyag rgya la brten nas// chos kyi phyag rgya rnam par sgom// de yi steng du phyag rgya che// gang las dam tshig 'byung ba'o// zhes/ klu sgrub kyi phyag rgya bzhi par yang 'gros de ka yin pas bod du grags pa'i chos lugs kun/ thos pa tsam du ma bzhag pa'ang tshig nyams su zad do// zhes pa'i lan rtsod spong du/ de skad gsungs pa de cir 'gyur brtag dgos te/ rab dbye mkhan pos/ nā ro mai tri gnyis kyang phyag rgya bzhi'i rnam gzhag gsang sngags rgyud sde nas bshad pa bzhin mdzad kyi/ rang bzo mi mdzad ces bshad pa la bsun 'byin gnang ba ni/ khong gnyis ni phyag rgya bzhi'i rnam gzhag rgyud nas bshad pa bzhin mdzad zer ba khyed rang gi ma go ba yin zer bar song 'dug pa'i phyir ro// zhes pa'i tshig 'khri 'di ni nyams 'gyur shin tu dod pa zhig byung snang ba 'di las rjes su dpags na/ rtsod spong mkhan po'i lung rigs kyi sku yon de yang sdug gsog kho na rang la ma ltos par thugs rab kyi rtsal las kyang grub bam snyam mo// ༈ rtsod spong du/ nā ro mai tri gnyis kyi phyag rgya bzhi'i lung 'dren gnang ba de ni/ rab dbye las/ blun po mkhas par bcos pa 'ga'// mdo rgyud lung sbyor byed mod kyi// de ni blun po'i kha shags ltar// gang du 'gro ba mi shes so// zhes pa'i lung des zin par snang ste/ zhes zer mod/ nged blun po'i khas len byed don mi 'dug kyang*/ mdo rgyud lung sbyor byed mod kyi// zhes pa la/ nā ro mai tri'i lung de mdo yin zer ram rgyud yin zer/ gtam byung rgyal du smra ba la dges lugs kyis lung bstan des sus zin things par dka' mod/

brjod bya'i phugs gang du 'gro mi shes pa ni nges par bden pa zhig go /de skabs kyi lan mchan bur/ de tsam la rtsod pa ci yin/ rab dbye bas bzhag pa'i go rim de ka paṇa chen gsum bzhed pa de min/ de'i rgyu mtshan lugs gsum khar phyag chen gsum pa dang*/ dam tshig bzhi par bshad 'dug pa 'brel legs par ltos/ zhes pa'i yang lan du/ ltas kyang 'brel che bar ma 'khums gsung ba mad/ sku na tshod smin pas rnam dpyod dang lhan cig spyan ras kyang 'gribs pas lan to// ༈ yang lan de'i 'phros su/ rgyu mtshan/ rab dbye las phyag rgya bzhi po nā ro mai tri gnyis kyang rgyud nas bshad pa bzhin mdzad gsung ba tsam las/ khong gnyis kyang go rim 'di 'dra zhig mdzad gsung ba yang mi snang*/ rab dbye'i go rim ltar byas na rgyud dang mi mthun ces kyang gsung bar mi spobs te/ phyag rgya bzhi po de la rgyud bstan bcos so sor go rim ngos 'dzin sbyor tshul mi 'dra ba mang dag cig snang bas go rim mi mthun pa tsam la rtsod par mi rigs zhes rtsod spong du bkod zin pa la/ slar yang go rim la rtsod pa yin gsung ba tsam las nus pa mi snang bas lan gyi spobs pa gtugs par go /zhes bkod mod/ blo gros mi zad pa'i gter chen padma dkar po/ rtsod pa phran bu de tsam gyis lan 'don pa la spobs pa gtugs par go ba de ni phyin ci log tu go bar gdon mi za'o// rgyu mtshan/ rtsod pa'i gzhir/ nā ro dang ni mai tri pa'i// phyag rgya chen po gang yin pa// de ni las dang chos dang ni// dam tshig dang ni phyag rgya che// gsang sngags rgyud las ji skad du// gsungs pa de nyid khong bzhed do// zhes gral sgrig khyer de la 'bru gnyer na/ nā ro mai tri'i phyag chen gang yin pa de ni/ dang por las rgya de nas chos rgya de nas dam rgya/ de'i rjes su phyag chen te gsang sngags kyi rgyud las ji skad gsungs pa de nyid nā ro mai tris bzhed do zhes pa tsam zhig thob bo// 'di la gzu bo'i blos zhib dpyod byas na/

rtsod spong du phyag rgya chen po ni nā ro mai tri gnyis kyang rgyud nas bshad pa bzhin mdzad gsung ba tsam las/ khong gnyis kyang go rim 'di 'dra zhig mdzad gsung ba yang mi snang zer ba de ni lhan pa 'debs nyes kho na ste/ gzhung der las chos dam phyag bzhi gral du sgrigs pa de ka go rim min nam/ phyag rgya bzhi'i rnam gzhag mi 'dra ba ji snyed rgyud las bshad pa thugs yul du bzhugs bzhin du rab dbyer byung ba'i go rim de rgyud gang dang yang mi mthun zhes shes ldan su zhig smra ste/ go rim la rtsod pa'i rgyu mtshan rab dbyer/ nā ro mai tri'i bzhed gzhung yin rgyu'i khul skyar ba de dang*/ khong gnyis kyi gzhung nas bshad nges shes pa de gnyis go rim ma mthun gsung rgyur 'dug pa/ de gnyis ma mthun te/ rab dbyer dam rgya gsum pa dang*/ phyag chen bzhi par byas/ jo bo gnyis po'i gzhung du phyag chen gsum pa dang*/ dam rgya bzhi par byas 'dug pa mngon sum la bsnyon pa ni/ mig ldan ji ltar lam nor yang*// g.yang sar goms pa 'jog mi srid// zhes pa bden med du btang ste/ mig gdangs bzhin du g.yang sar gom pa 'jog lugs la gzigs shig de bzhin mkhas pa 'khrul na yang*// sangs rgyas bstan la 'da' mi nus// zhes gsungs mod kyang*// deng sang gi mkhas smyon kha cig shor na sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la'ang ci cha'o// de lta mod kyi/ jo bo rnam gnyis bzhed pa'i gzhung dang mthun pa'i rgyud 'ga' zhig gi go rim bkod nas gsungs na legs rgyu la bsgrub bya sgrub byed 'dzol bar mdzad pa de/ rjes 'jug 'ga' zhig 'bru mar bzhin du 'tshir ba'i 'tshir dpyad du bkod pa'o// yang na bar gyi tshig rkang gnyis mi mngon par byas nas/ nā ro dang ni mai tri pa'i// phyag rgya chen po gang yin pa// gsang sngags rgyud las ji skad du// gsungs pa de nyid khong bzhed do// zhes brda' sprod kyi gzhung las 'byung ba bzhin skabs su bab pa'i bsdu ba'am/

yi ge phri bsnan gyi nges tshig la sbyar na grub mtha' skyong bde bas/ rjes su 'jug pa rnams dbugs dbyung ba'i bka' drin mdzod cig ces 'jam pa'i dbyangs la smreng gsol lo// ༈ yang rtsod spong 'phror/ nā ro mai tri gnyis char gyi lugs drangs pa der/ phyag rgya bzhi'i zlas phye ba'i phyag chen de ni chos kyi phyag rgya la brten pa dang*/ de yang las kyi phyag rgya la brten dgos par bshad 'dug pa la/ khyed ni mdo lugs kyi phyag chen dang*/ rgyud sde 'og ma'i phyag chen sogs 'chol pa zhig bzhed par snang bas/ mdo rang rkang las las kyi phyag rgya sogs ma bshad pa dang*/ khas blangs 'gal 'dug pa'i phyir ro// gal te dngos btags phye na de ltar mi bzhed do zhes gsung na 'thol lo bshags so// zhes bkod pa la/ mdo dang rgyud sde phyi ma sogs 'chol par btang ba'i chos spong gi las mi zad pa bsags kyang*/ de ma thag 'thol lo bshags so gsung bar 'dug pa/ mkhas pa'i sdig pa lci yang yang*// zhes pa der snang bas legs so// dpal ldan sa skya pa'i bla chen gong ma'i gsung las/ brjod pa tshig gi phyag rgya chen po spros bral dang*/ sgom pa dmigs pa'i phyag rgya chen po mi rtog pa'i ting nge 'dzin sogs dang*/ nyams myong phyag rgya chen po ting nge 'dzin gyi dmigs pa de sgom pa'i nyams myong ste/ de gsum mtshan nyid kyi theg par yang bstan ces bka' 'bum na snang mod kyang nyan mkhan med pa ni dus kyi dbang gis yin no// nā ro mai tri'i gzhung gi don las kyi phyag rgya ni mi mo'am/ lha klu gnod sbyin sogs kyi bu mo/ chos rgya dang ye rgya don gcig tu byas pa de yid rig phyag rgya chen po ni rnam kun mchog ldan gyi stong nyid de/ gzhan gyi bud med brten par bya zhes pa'i bud med/ dam tshig gi phyag rgya ni stong nyid de dang zung du 'jug rgyu'i 'gyur med dam 'pho med kyi bde chen yin pas/

nā ro'i gzhung gi 'phros las/ rgyu dang sgom pa thob bya dang*// de bzhin bzhi pa lhun gyis grub// zhes go rim bzhin du sbyar ro// de dag kyang phyag rgya bzhi la rim gyis sbyar 'os pa'i gang zag gi dbang du byas nas/ snga ma snga ma rgyu dang*/ phyi ma phyi ma 'bras bur bzhed/ dbang po ches rno ba dag la/ las kyi phyag rgya yongs dor zhing*// ye shes phyag rgya rnam par spangs// phyag rgya che las yang dag skyes// lhan skyes gzhan dang 'grogs pas min// zhes phyag rgya dang po gnyis la ma brten par/ sems rnam par dben pa las byung ba'i phyag chen de stong nyid kyi gzugs brnyan bsgrubs/ de 'od gsal du gzhugs pa'i zung 'jug bstan pa nyid kyis don gnyis 'grub bo// de ltar dpal ldan dwags po'i dkar brgyud la grags pa'i phyag rgya chen po ni 'di'i dam rgya dang don gcig ste/ phyag chen de zung 'jug yin pa'i phyir ro// de'i phyir rtsod spong du/ phyag chen de ni chos rgya la brten pa dang*/ de yang las rgya la brten dgos par bshad 'dug pa la zhes smras nas/ skyon 'jug pa'i go skabs bye dogs nas dam rgya'i 'phros tsam yang ma btang ba 'di g.yo sgyu'i rtsod par mthong yang*/ lkug ma'i spyang bcos de re zhig de khar zhog thong*/ phyag rgya'i go rim mi mthun pa rnams mthun par sgrub pa'i ched du/ 'phags pa klu sgrub nyid kyis kyang*/ phyag rgya bzhi par 'di skad gsungs// las kyi phyag rgya mi shes pas// chos kyi phyag rgya'ang mi shes na// phyag rgya chen po'i ming tsam yang*// rtogs pa nyid ni mi srid gsungs// zhes bka' brdzus lhan thabs kyis brgyan pa'i bstan bcos de dang por su zhig gis brtsams snyam du bsams so// de ni 'phags pa klu sgrub kyis so zhe na/ de des ma mdzad par a bhā ya ka ras man ngag snye mar bshad do// 'o na khyed rang gis grub pa sde bdun gyi gy bar ma bgrangs sam zhe na bgrangs mod kyi/

de ni klu sgrub snying pos mdzad nges kyi phyag rgya bzhi pa lhad med de yin pas/ ming tsam la yang ci zhig rtsod zer ba der snang ngo*// gan mdzod las/ 'di ni klu sgrub kyi gzhung las mi 'byung zhing*/ der ni de las log pa zhig gsungs te/ de la dga' zhing mgu bas chos kyi phyag rgya'i gtam tsam yang mi shes so// chos kyi phyag rgya mi shes pas las kyi phyag rgya bcos ma 'ba' zhig las ma bcos pa'i lhan cig skyes pa'i rang bzhin 'byung zhing skye bar ga la 'gyur/ rigs mthun pa'i rgyu las rigs mthun pa'i 'bras bu skye bar 'gyur gyi rigs mi mthun pa las ma yin no// ji ltar sā lu'i sa bon las sā lu'i myu gu skye bar 'gyur gyi ko ṭa pa las ma yin no// de bzhin du ma bcos pa'i chos kyi phyag rgyas rang bzhin las ma bcos pa'i lhan cig skyes pa 'byung ngo*// de'i phyir chos kyi phyag rgya'i rgyu las mi phyed pa'i phyag rgya chen po skye bar 'gyur ro// zhes 'byung bas so// zhes pa'i lan rtsod spong du/ 'di ni 'phags pa klu sgrub nyid kyis kyang*/ phyag rgya bzhi par 'di skad gsungs// zhes pa'i gzhung lugs bsun 'byin pa'i zol gyis rang nyid sun phyung bar song bas lung bstan snga ma de nyid do// ci'i phyir snyam na khyed rang gis drangs pa'i klu sgrub kyi lung de ni/ mi phyed pa'i phyag rgya chen po chos kyi phyag rgya las 'byung dgos par/ sā lu'i myu gu 'byung ba'i dpes gtan la phab nas/ khyed cag gis chos kyi phyag rgya'i ming tsam yang ma bstan pa'i/ mdo rgyud las phyag chen gyi ming btags pa thams cad phyag chen yin no zhes dngos btags kyi rnam dbye ma phyed par zhal gyis bzhes pa'i phyir ro// zhes bris mod/ nged kyis gdul bya'i bsam pa dang*/ dbang po dang*/ khams dang*/ mos pa sna tshogs kyi rjes su 'gro ldog bstan pa'i phyir/ phyag rgya'i go rim sna tshogs dang*/

ngos 'dzin sna tshogs dang*/ rgyu 'bras su 'gro tshul sna tshogs dang*/ ming sna tshogs kyis bstan to zhes rgya 'bag gi mig bzhin du 'phrul chags pa gan mdzod du gsungs kyang*/ tshig rtsa gtan nas rang mi zin par slar a 'thas kyi klan ka 'dzugs pa 'di lta bu ni/ chang ma bzhes pa'i skam 'gong*/ ja rlung langs pa'i rlon 'gong gis bskul bar zad do// des na khyed kyi phyag rgya bzhi pa'i gzhung gnod byed du bkod nas gan mdzod 'gog pa'i zol gyis lam 'bras bkag pa yin te/ 'tshang rgya ba'i nye rgyur rang dang spang rtogs mtshungs pa'i las kyi phyag rgya nges par dgos par bshad pa la/ 'dir las kyi phyag rgya bcos ma 'ba' zhig las/ ma bcos pa'i lhan cig skyes pa mi 'byung bar bshad pa'i phyir ro// nged kyi 'dod pa la mi gnod kyi steng du gzhan gong 'og mang por yang phan pa yin te/ rigs mthun gyi rgyu 'bras 'byung tshul bzhin/ ma bcos pa'i chos kyi phyag rgya'i rgyu las/ mi phyed pa'i lhan cig skyes pa 'byung bar bshad pas nged kyi 'dod thog tu 'khyol lo// dngos btags ma phyed ces yang yang smra ba 'di cung mi rigs te/ shin tu dkar ba dri ma med pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyi phyag rgya zhes mdo sder gsungs pa lta bu dang*/ 'jam dpal rtsa rgyud/ rnam snang mngon byang*/ de nyid 'dus pa sogs rgyud sde phyi ma dang*/ bla med kyi rgyud so sor spyir phyag rgya bzhi dang bye brag phyag chen gyi rnam gzhag gsungs pa rnams la rang rang so so'i thad gdong de dang der dngos gnas de kha bden/ rgyu mtshan/ mu dra zhes pa la phyag dang rgya so sor phral ba'i bshad pa dang*/ gcig tu bsdams nas bshad pa sogs byung mod/ gang ltar yang 'dra/ rdo rje 'dis ni gdab pa nyid// des na phyag rgyar brjod par bya// zhes phyag rgya'i don mi 'da' bar rgyas btab pa zhig la zer la/ des na mi 'da' ba zhig la phyag rgya'i sgra btags na dngos por gnas pa ste/

dper na rtogs pa dang ldan pa la rtogs ldan du btags pa lta bu/ gal te rgya las 'da' ba zhig la phyag rgyar btags na btags pa ba ste/ rtogs pa dang mi ldan pa la rtogs ldan du btags pa lta bu yin te/ 'di 'dra dgongs pa la ming tshig yi ge'i 'jug tshul rgyas par ston pa'i gzhung lugs sgra snyan ngag mngon brjod sdeb sbyor sogs la bslab dgos kyang*/ mi la ras pa'i tshod ma bzhin/ thal dang sdor dang tshwa 'debs rgyu med nas lo 'ga' thal lo zer// ༈ yang rtsod spong du/ de ltar go rim mi mthun pa mang dag byung zhes pa'i mchan bur/ nges pa ci yod/ bzhi par byas pa dang*/ gsum par byas pa ma mthun zhes smra zhes bris snang ba yang nus pa zad pa kho na'o zhes yang lan du bkod pa de la/ go rim la dam bca' dang gtan tshigs go rim ma mtshungs pa la brtsad kyi/ spyir phyag rgya'i rnam dbye la nges pa med de/ phyag chen gsum par byas tshe stong gzugs la blo rtse gtod/ bzhi par byas tshe zung 'jug la blo rtse gtod dgos pas blo rtse'i gtad sa ma mthun gsung rgyur gnang ba la/ bka' mchan gyi nus pa la mi dpyod par tshigs bongs chung ba tsam la brnyas par 'dug ste/ dgra bo'i nus pa ma brtags par// nyam chung na yang brnyas mi bya// ṭi ṭṭi bha la brnyas pa yis// nam mkha' lding gis rgya mtsho bcom// zhes bka' mchan dang*/ de la brnyas mkhan dang*/ de 'joms mkhan gsum ka tshig rim pa gcig gis lung du bstan par shes par byos shig de yang kha la dpags pa'i so'i rnam pa/ lan nyung ngus chog par dgongs nas mchan bu tsam gnang ba yin na'ang za phyir dgongs khrid la snying por byed pa'i grwa pa 'dras/ bsod snyoms las brnyed pa'i rtsam pa phal cher bla ma la yang yang gtor ba'i thugs lang gis/ gan mdzod pa'i lan 'debs kyi nus pa zad pa kho na'o zhes yid bder spyad cing zhal gyi padma las kyang shin tu tsha ba'i zil pa skyug mod/ nus pa zad na ci ma rung snyam du smon na'ang*/

de la snying po med de/ khyed kyi yid smon tsam gyis ni// de la gnod pa'i rgyur mi 'gyur// zhes pa bzhin no// don tshan 'di la 'di man chad kyi rtsod spong yang lan dang bcas pa'i tshig don rnams sngar song ba tsho zlos bur snang yang*/ gdul bya'i ngo bzung nas mchan bu tsam 'debs pa gnang 'dug pa de kas chog par shes nas slar ma zlos la/ mkhyen spyan gsal ba rnams kyis/ don 'bras gar song gar 'ded pa// nga 'dra tshol dang rnyed na mtshar// zhes pa ltar dpyad kyi/ g.yom rgyugs kyi dbang du ma btang zhig rab dbye'i gzhung 'di dag 'gal med dpyis phyin par 'chad pa'i blo gros shig kho bo'i snying khar 'jam pa'i dpal dang lhan cig dgyes dgu'i gar la bzhugs pa 'di/ re zhig phyir mi dbyung ba ni/ dgag bya dang ni dgos pa gnyis// gtso bo gang che'i dbang du thong*// zhes pa bzhin du'o// 'dir smras pa/ lung rigs rtse brgya gzings pa rdo rje'i mtshon// mkhas pa grags pa'i mu khyud kyis phyar tshe// smra ngan sbyin mas bskyed pa'i rtsa lag kun// phye mar btags pa'i rdul phran bzhin du phra// dbyangs can mgrin par bzung ba'i bshes gnyen rnams// legs bshad spro ba'i ljags kyi yal 'dab dmar// phyogs kyi 'khor lor brkyangs pa'i dge mtshan 'bum// gzigs mor spyon pa'i spyan ras de ngo mtshar// bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa'o// // yang rgyal ba'i gan mdzod chen po las/ dbang bskur bzhi pa ma thob par// phyag rgya chen po sogs sgom dang*// zhes pa'ang tshig sboms so// rgyu mtshan phyag rgya chen po zhes pa'i sgra ni spyod rgyud rnal 'byor rgyud du'ang bshad la/ de dag cam zhog rnal 'byor chen po nyid kyi 'dus par/ rnam par snang mdzad phyag rgya che// sku gsung thugs kyis mtshan pa'o// zhes bskyed rim la phyag chen du bzhag pa dang*/ brtag gnyis las/ de las skyes pa'i rnal 'byor ma// de yi bde ba za ba nyid// de dang lhan cig phyag rgya che// bde ba sbyin pa'i dngos grub 'gyur// zhes pas las rgya phyag chen du bzhag pa dang*/

dus 'khor rtsa rgyud las/ dung can ma 'di phyag rgya che// de ni gtum mor brjod par bya// dang*/ so sor sdud la phyag rgya che// nam mkha' stong pa'i mtshan nyid do// zhes gtum mo dang sgyu lus phyag chen du bzhag pa sogs ma phyed pas so// zhes pa'i lan rtsod spong du/ dbang bskur bzhi pa ma thob par// phyag rgya chen po sogs sgom dang*// zhes pa'i tshig sboms so gsung ba de ma brtags pa dag gi ngor mad par snang ste/ bzhi pa ma thob kyang dbang 'og ma'i skabs su phyag chen dpe'i ye shes skye ba yod pa'i phyir ro// rab dbye'i dgongs pa ni/ spyi ming mtshon bya don gyi phyag chen la bye brag tu btags pa ste/ mtshon bya don gyi phyag chen dbang bzhi pa ma thob par mi skye ba'i phyir ro// zhes zer mod/ gong 'og mang por dngos btags phyed ma phyed kyi gleng mo mdzad pa'i dngos btags de ni 'di lta bus mtshon nus te/ don gyi ye shes phyag chen dngos dang*/ dpe'i ye shes phyag chen btags pa bar mdzad dgos pa la/ da lam phyag chen dpe'i ye shes zer ba byas na/ dpe'i ye shes de yang phyag chen mtshan nyid pa yin rgyu'i khul gyis sbubs 'dren mdzad nas gzhan la gshe ba yang mi 'os so// spyi ming bye brag la btags gsung ba de yang*/ nyid rang gi mngon par shes pas dgongs na ma gtogs gzhung gi dngos shugs la mi snang ngo*// ༈ yang rtsod spong du/ sngar gyi rgyu mtshan sgrub byed bkod pa des ni/ dam bca' de yang chud gsan par snang ste/ phyag rgya chen po'i ming btags tshad phyag chen mtshan nyid par khas blangs pas/ mthar mi blun po la ba lang zhes btags pa'i mi de yang ba lang yin zhes khas len dgos byung ba'i phyir te/ dngos btags kyi rnam dbye gcig kyang ma phyed 'dug pa'i phyir ro// zhes 'dzer mod/ phyag chen gyi ming btags tshad phyag chen mtshan nyid pa yin ces nged kyis ma smras pa'i khar/

dngos btags 'byed tshul rgyas par brjod zin pas skyon mi 'jug la/ rgyud sde phyi ma dang*/ bskyed rim/ las rgya/ gtum mo/ sgyu lus phyag chen du bzhag pa de rnams/ dbang bzhi pa dang 'brel ba'i gnas lugs phyag chen de ma yin kyang*/ rang sa rang sa'i phyag chen mtshan nyid pa ni shin tu yang yin no// shes bya'i chos bsam gyis mi khyab pa dper 'god rgyu yod bzhin du phyag chen gyi dpe blun po dang ba lang la 'jog pa 'di yang ci zhig 'dra// ༈ yang rtsod spong du/ khas blangs nang 'gal yang 'byung ste/ 'dir bskyed rim dang las rgya sogs phyag chen du khas blangs nas/ 'og tu rang lugs kyi phyag chen ngos 'dzin pa'i tshe shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la ngos bzung 'dug pa'i phyir ro// zhes bris pa la/ smos zin pa de ka zlos pa ste/ bskyed rim dang las rgya sogs spyir phyag chen yin par zhal gyis bzhes/ lung gis rgyab mnan pa yin la/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi bgrod pa gcig pa'i lam po che dpal dwags po dkar brgyud la grags pa 'di nyid shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la ngos bzung*/ de 'thad ldan sgrub byed kyi lung rigs zab cing mang ba dag yod kyang yi ges bsun nas bzhag go /des na khas blangs nang 'gal gyi srol nged la med pas ma bsnyon cig phyag chen ba lang gi dpes gzhal ba'i mchan bur/ gong du phyag chen du ming btags pa de/ de skabs su khas mi len na btags nas ci bya/ de thams cad gcig tu khas ma blangs pas/ la lar lag pa'i phyag rgya/ bskyed rim sogs dmigs bsal mang du 'dug pa la bad rlung gi skyon du gyur zhes gsungs pa la/ yang lan du/ spyir bka' bstan bcos kyi babs 'gros la/ ming de la dngos ming dang btags ming gnyis/ dngos ming la bshad 'jug mu gsum/ btags ming la 'dra 'brel rgyu mtshan du byas pa sogs mang dag yod pas dngos btags phyed dgos pa zhig mkhas pa'i spyi lugs yin kyang*/

khong phyag chen pa la rbad kham de tsam los yong*/ ming btags tshad la dngos btags mi dgos par/ phyag chen du ming btags pa'i nyon mongs pa de ni phyag chen/ sangs rgyas su ming btags pa'i tha mal skye bo de ni sangs rgyas/ seng ger ming btags pa'i mi de ni seng ge glang chen du ming btags pa'i sangs rgyas de ni glang chen sogs/ phyag rgya chen po'i klong yangs kyi rnam 'phrul ngo mtshar ba'i gtam bsam las 'das/ bad rlung langs pa'i rtog ge sbubs 'thums khyod la de rang mkho// nad bad rlung langs pa'i chal chol de// gzhan gso rig mkhas na 'tsho ba'ang srid// chos phyag rgya chen po'i 'ur shang 'di// khong rgyal rnams 'dzom yang dka' se ba// zhes bkod mod/ sngon du smras pa bzhin/ dngos po gang la dngos ming ngam btags ming ci 'dra zhig btags kyang 'dra/ de la dpyad na/ sgra bshad 'jug mu gsum mam// 'dra 'brel sogs gang rung gi sgo nas btags pa'i ming re re'i thog tu'ang dngos btags gnyis gnyis 'jug ste/ dngos ming la mtshon na/ glang po'i mchus kyang lag pa'i bya ba byed pas lag ldan ces btags pa dang*/ glang po mchu nad can gyi mchus lag pa'i bya ba byed mi nus kyang lag ldan du btags pa lta bu dngos btags phye ba dang*/ btags ming la mtshon na/ mi sna nyag gtum po la seng ger btags pa dang*/ sna mi nyag cing rgyud dul ba la seng ger btags pa lta bus dngos btags phye na 'ong ste/ dge bshes chen por song yang 'brog rtags ma sangs pa gda' ba/ des na/ sangs rgyas la glang po chen por mtshan btags nas/ gzhan dang mi nor ba'i phyir du bya ba byas pa/ byed pa byas pa/ khur bor ba zhes sogs dang*/ sangs rgyas la seng ger btags nas/ gzhan dang mi bsre ba'i phyir du/ chos kyi 'khor lo bskor mdzad pa'i// shākya seng ge de la 'dud// ces dang*/ mi yi seng ge khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes pa lta bu/ de bzhin du 'gres rkang ded pas legs po 'ong mchis so// de lta bu'i drang gtam thugs su cung ma shong tsa na stong skad 'ur shang 'dra zhig tu dgongs pa 'dra/

don dang ma 'brel ba'i 'ud gog ci la zhu/ phyag rgya chen po'i gnas lugs tshul bzhin du smra ba la/ bsam brjod kyi yul las ring du bskal ba'i gshis kyis sangs rgyas tsho la'ang ka se ka yod gsung ba ni bden pa 'dra ste/ grub sde las/ gang zhig gis ni nye bar brjod pa'i dus dag tu// thams cad mkhyen pa'ang tshig gis dbul 'gyur rgyal gyur cig /ces 'byung bas/ khong rgyal rnams 'dzom yang dka' se ba// ces thugs gcong mgur du bzhes pa'ang mad mchis/ de bas bad rlung gis dbu 'khor ba de sku na smin pa dang bcas 'phral yun du nyen che bas bsnyun gyi gsos sman rgyun chags su bsten pa zhu lags// ༈ rtsod spong du/ khas blangs nang 'gal yang 'byung ste/ sogs kyi lan mchan bur/ bskyed rim phyag rgya bzhir gsungs pa'i phyag chen de skabs su sgom mi dgos par thal ba la lan blon zhes gsungs pa la/ yang lan du/ ci yang ma 'brel te/ phyag chen la shes phyin yin pa zhig dgos na/ bskyed rim dang las rgya yang shes phyin du thal te/ phyag chen yin pa'i phyir/ rtags khas blangs zhes pa la dngos lan mi gnang bar/ bskyed rim skabs su phyag chen bsgom mi dgos par thal/ bskyed rim phyag chen min pa'i phyir/ gsung bar snang bas/ mkhas rnams dges pa'i dga' ston du ma gyur to// zhes bkod mod/ rtags de 'dra zhal gyis ma bzhes te/ rang lugs dwags po'i dkar brgyud kyi bzhed dgongs gnas lugs phyag rgya chen po de shes phyin yin gsungs kyi/ gzhan shes phyin yin na phyag chen yin pa'i khyab mtha' dang*/ phyag chen yin na shes phyin yin pa'i khyab mtha' zhal gyis ma bzhes so// rigs pa'i grwar phyag phebs pa tshos 'di 'dra'i thal 'gyur gsung ba lta zhig ces lkog lab phran bu shor ba la thugs ma khro zhig/ ༈ yang gan mdzod las/ dbang bskur dag dang ma 'brel ba// de la phyag rgya chen po bkag /ces pa ni nam yang mi rigs te/

de dgag pa'i gzhung ma dmigs pa dang*/ mdo lugs kyis 'tshang rgya bar khas blangs pa dang nang 'gal zhing*/ gzhan yang 'thad ldan gzhi phyag rgya chen po yul ci nas mi thon/ gzhi phyag rgya chen po'i tha snyad khas mi len snyam na/ brtag gnyis su/ ga bur nyid ni bdag med ma// bde ba bdag med tshul can nyid// de yi bde ba phyag rgya che// lte ba'i dkyil 'khor nyid du gnas// dang po'i dbyangs yig rang bzhin te// blo zhes sangs rgyas rnams kyis btags// zhes bsub bam/ zhes pa'i lan rtsod spong du/ 'di'i lan la gsum/ dgag pa'i gzhung ma dmigs zhes pa'i lan/ mdo lugs kyi 'tshang rgya ba dang 'gal ba'i lan/ gzhi phyag rgya chen po yul thon pa dang 'gal ba'i lan no// dang po ni/ dbang bskur dag dang ma 'brel ba// de la phyag rgya chen po bkag /ces pa ni/ bla med dbang bskur ma thob pa'i gang zag gi rgyud la phyag chen ye shes skye ba rgyud las bkag pa ste/ mdo rgyud tshad ldan gang las kyang ma bshad ces pa'i don yin la/ zhes bkod pa'i lan 'di lta ste/ gong du/ dbang bskur bzhi pa ma thob par// phyag rgya chen po sogs bsgom dang*// zhes dang*/ 'dir yang*/ dbang bskur dag dang ma 'brel ba// de la phyag rgya chen po bkag /ces sogs sdom gsum gyi gzhung gi dngos shugs ci rigs pas phyag rgya ba la klan kar mdzad pa'i dgongs pa/ de dag dbang bskur ma byas par phyag chen gyi lam ston pa zhig go snyam thugs la bzhag nas tshigs bcad mang po brjod pa'i gnyen por/ phal tshig ltar na snying ma sdug gi lan ci rigs pa gan mdzod du bkod/ mchan bur yang btags pa yin gyi gya tshoms su ma yin no// gzhan yang*/ dbang bskur med par lam zab mo// bsgom pas sangs rgyas thob snyam na// dbang bskur med par lam zab mo// bsgom pa ngan 'gro'i rgyu ru gsungs// zhes pa la'ang*/ 'di bden na mdo lugs pa zab mo stong pa nyid sgom mkhan tsho ngan song gsum gyi gang du skyes yod ces sogs bsun 'byin mdzad yod pa'ang 'di dang mtshungs so// 'o na phyag rgya pa'i lugs la/

khrid 'di'i sngon du dbang bskur mdzad pa zhig gam/ 'on te mi mdzad ces dogs pa bsus nas bshad na/ 'di thad kyi rab dbye/ gan mdzod/ rtsod spong*/ yang lan rnams su bris pa'i don rtsa khrol bde ba la bsams nas cung zad bshad na/ dpal ldan sa skya pa'i bka' srol la/ rnal 'byor bla med kyi gang zag snod rung de/ smin byed dbang bzhi dang grol byed rim pa gnyis nges pa can la rim gyis bslab dgos par bzhed/ dkar brgyud pa ngo ma rnams kyi bzhed srol la/ rgyud las/ gang zhig dbang ni rab phye ba// rang gi dkyil 'khor cho gas sbyin// zhes pa'i lung dang sbyar nas/ rim 'jug pa spros pas 'dul dgos pa la las rim rgyas pa dang 'brel ba'i dbang bskur rim can du/ 'bring po la mos pa'i thod brgal ba la lus dkyil dang rdo rje ye shes kyi dbang lta bu nges med du/ dbang rnon la rtogs pa don gyi dbang sems thog tu cig car bskur ba'i shes byed du/ phyag rgya chen po'i dbang bskur ba// sogs kyi lung 'dren mdzad la/ phyi ma 'di la dbang gi sngon du 'gro ba'i dkyil 'khor yang*/ rang sems byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor zhes dus 'khor du gsungs pa de la/ snying po len pa'i sgra bshad 'jug kyang tshang ba dang*/ der bskur bya'i dbang yang*/ bla ma dam pa'i byin rlabs dang*/ thabs la mkhas pa'i brda' thabs ci rigs pa'i sgo nas/ rang bzhin lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes kyi rang ngo sprod pa kho na dbang mchog tu gyur par bzhed ces pa ni snying po btus pa ste rgyas par gzhan du shes par bya'o// de ltar yin mod kyang*/ sa skya pa'i chos nyan thams cad rim 'jug pa dang*/ dkar brgyud pa'i chos nyan thams cad cig car ba ma yin phyin/ gnyis thad nas lam gyi 'jug ldog ma 'dzol ba zhig dgos rgyu la/ cig gis rnam pa kun tu rim 'jug pa bkri tshul dang*/ cig shos kyis rnam pa kun tu cig car ba bkri tshul gyi phyogs re bzung nas chos kyi gtam smra bar mdzad mod/

des ni/ ji ltar nad pa na ba la// sman pas sman ni gtong ba ltar// de bzhin sangs rgyas sems can la// ji tsam bzod pa'i chos ston to// zhes gsungs pa de tshig tsam du 'jog pa la gnyis ka gung 'grig gda'/ 'on kyang phyag chen khrid du ston tshe/ zhi gnas kyi myong ba skye lugs la dpags nas 'jug tu ngo sprod pa dang mi sprod pa'i rnam dbye mdzad pa yin no// zhes don gyi khog phub nas/ tshig gi lan ni/ dbang bskur dag dang ma 'brel ba// de la phyag rgya chen po bkag /ces pa la/ de bkag pa'i gzhung tshad ldan rnyed na lta/ rtsod pa kho nad grol dang gdon grol la 'gro ba 'dug ste/ de ma byung bas ka mdo rgyud tshad ldan gang las kyang ma bshad ces pa'i don yin la zhes zhol le 'jog dgos byung ba lags// de 'dra ba de 'di dang*/ gzhan gyi smin byed rgyud las bkag /ces sogs mang po byung ba la/ rang mchan du grags pa der yang lung khungs ma drangs pas/ de tsho la lung med nges yin kyang*/ chos rje pas/ dkar brgyud la co 'dri ba'i phyir de 'dra bkod pa shin tu mang*/ des na gzhung lugs 'di mtha' drug gi skya bar la ma drangs par sgra zin tsam la 'chel na 'bub mchis so// rtsod spong du/ de ltar ma bshad gsungs pa 'di shes ldan gzur gnas zhig gis 'gog mi rigs te/ bkag na rang nyid kyi spyi bor gnam lcags kyi thog 'bab pa'i phyir te/ khyed rang gis kyang phyag chen mtshan nyid pa phyag rgya bzhi'i nang tshan phyi ma gsum gang rung zhig la bzhed par snang la/ phyag rgya bzhi'i nang tshan phyag chen de rgyud la skye ba la dbang bskur thob pa zhig dgos pa kho na bshad pa'i phyir te/ phyag rgya bzhi'i nang tshan phyag rgya chen po ni/ chos kyi phyag rgya zhes bya ba mtshon byed dpe'i ye shes la brten nas skye dgos la/ chos kyi phyag rgya de ni las kyi phyag rgya zhes bya ba dngos sam ye shes kyi phyag rgya la brten nas skye dgos shing*/

phyag rgya de brten pa la thabs shes gnyis char dbang gis smin pa zhig dgos pa'i phyir te/ dam tshig dag dang mi ldan par// rig ma brten par dga' ba dang*// zhes dbang gis ma smin pa'i phyag rgya brten pa la yan lag gi ltung ba 'byung bar bshad pa'i phyir ro// rnam dpyod ldan na de tsam gyis dgongs 'tshal lo// zhes bkod pa 'di sku khams nyog pa'i dus shig bris par snang ste/ don rkang gcig la phyir te sum brtsegs sgrub pa'i lung rigs rnams kyang skor thag ring la mthu chung bar snang ba'i phyir ro// de yang*/ phyag chen mtshan nyid pa phyag rgya bzhi'i nang tshan phyi ma gsum gang rung zhig la bzhed par snang la zer ba de mi bden te/ phyi ma gnyis gang rung la bzhed kyi gsum gang rung la mi bzhed/ chos kyi phyag rgya mtshon byed dpe'i ye shes la brten nas mi skye/ mtshon byed dpe'i ye shes chos kyi phyag rgya la brten nas skye/ las kyi phyag rgya ye shes kyi phyag rgya la brten nas mi skye/ ye shes kyi phyag rgya las kyi phyag rgya la brten nas skye ba lags mod/ rgyu 'bras go log de 'dra phyin chad ma gsung zhig las rgya brten pa la thabs shes gnyis ka dbang gis smin pa dgos pa'i sgrub byed kyi lung de yang ma 'brel te/ dam bca' la thabs shes gnyis zer ba byas nas/ sgrub byed la rig ma dbang gis smin dgos pa tsam las ma byung bas so// rtsod pa de ni der zad na nged kyi spyi bor 'bab rgyu'i gnam lcags kyi thog de da ga re/ 'di ni ser skya'i rtogs brjod las/ gang phyir stobs mthu 'dod pa yis// ri la spyi bos brdung bar rtsom// zhes pa der snang ngo*// ༈ rtsod spong du/ des kyang mi dgongs na/ brtag pa gnyis par/ sangs rgyas kun gyi sdom pa ni// e waṃ rnam par rab tu gnas// e waṃ rnam pa'i bde chen po// zhes pa dang*/ khyed rang gis gong du drangs pa'i/ bde ba bdag med tshul can nyid// ces pa de dag gnad gcig pas/

de skabs kyi bde chen skye ba yang dbang la ltos mi dgos par 'gyur te/ phyag rgya bzhi po de bsten pa'am/ bsgom pa'am/ skye ba la dbang gtan nas mi dgos 'dug pa'i phyir ro// gal te shin tu 'dod thog tu babs so snyam na/ gzhung snga ma de'i 'phro de nyid las/ dbang las yang dag shes par 'gyur// zhes de 'dra'i ye shes skye ba dbang la ltos par bshad pa de ma dgongs sam/ zhes bris so// skabs 'dir gsol ja thon pas sngar las sku khams dwangs su song*/ 'on kyang da dung skyon 'di snang ste/ de la phyag rgya chen po bkag /ces pa'i lan du/ de dgag pa'i gzhung ma dmigs pa dang zhes gsungs pa la/ dgag byed kyi lung gis shin tu dbul bar gyur nas de la dbang dgos pa'i sgrub byed ji tsam bkod kyang*/ rtsa ba'i gnod byed du ma song bas sha go mar gyis ma chod// ༈ yang rtsod spong du/ ci ste da dung phan dgongs bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho rangs par ma gyur na/ 'di skad zhu 'tshal/ mtshon bya don gyi phyag rgya chen po zhes grags pa de rgyud la 'char ba la bla med kyi dbang thob dgos te/ zhes sogs smos pa yang sngar 'khyud la dar 'khyud chags nas bogs ma thon 'dug pas/ mar la sreg sha mi nyan no// de 'dras phan dgongs bdud rtsi'i rgya mtshos rangs par ga la 'gyur/ lar yang*/ rdo rje theg pa'i sgor zhugs nas// dbang bskur las gzhan chos med do// zhes zer gyin/ dbang bskur las gzhan pa'i bskyed rdzogs dang*/ bskyed rdzogs las gzhan pa'i dbang bskur 'tshol ba'i ngal ba brgya phrag brten nas ci zhig bya ste/ sa paṇa gyi lung mnyam po la nye ring bya mi rigs so// ༈ rtsod spong du/ rgyud sde chen po gzhan phar zhog /ye shes snying po zhes pa'i rgyud nyung ngu zhig las/ zhes lung 'dren mdzad pa la/ mchan bur/ rgyud sde chen po phar bzhag pa'i skyon ka byung gda'o// zhes gsungs pa ni shin tu mad par mthong ste/

phyogs snga'i 'dod pa la car 'phog tu gtong ba'i gnod byed ma 'byor bar ci bya 'tshang brlag gi skabs 'dir/ rgyud sde chen po tsho'i nang na dbang dang ma 'brel ba'i phyag rgya chen po bkag pa'i gzhung yod pa byas/ de khong la thugs rgyus yod pa byas/ de yang sku khams dwangs pa cig dang 'grig na lta/ dgos med kyi lab lob mang po de tshos ci zhig bya ste/ de ma byung tsa na phar mi 'jog ka med du gyur pa lags so// rab dbyer/ rgyud kyi rgyal po gzhan dang ni// bstan bcos chen po gzhan las kyang*// dbang bskur dag dang ma 'brel ba// de la phyag rgya chen po bkag /ces lung mang po yod rgyu'i khul gyis shog ral gzi brjid can mdzad pa la dbu 'khor nas mang du glengs kyang*/ lag yod du phyogs snga'i rtsa bar gnod nges kyi lung tshig rkang gcig kyang ma 'byor ba de ci zhig 'dra/ rgyud sde chen po phar zhog ces gsung khyer dang*/ ye shes snying po la rgyud nyung ngu zhes gsung lugs la bltas na/ tshig bongs che chung la rgyud sde che chung byas pa 'dra zhig tu dgongs mdog kha yang*/ de 'dra min pas ye shes snying po la mi brnyas par zhu'o// rgyud de'i lung rnams shin tu legs mod kyang*/ da lam gyi dgag sgrub 'di la dngos su phan gnod mi snang bas skyor zlos ma dgos/ gong gi de tsho'i sgrib zol du rtsod spong las/ yid ches pa'i khungs dang*/ snyan brgyud bzhi ldan gyi bla ma tshad ma'i zhal gyi padma las rnyed pa'i bdud rtsi yin pas lung rigs ltar snang gis bsun dbyung bar ga la nus/ de'i phyir bdag cag gi ston pas phyag rgya bzhi'i phyag rgyas bsdams pa'i phyag rgya chen po/ bla med dbang dang 'brel mi dgos zhes smra ba'i zhal gyi padma ni ri bong can gyi 'od kyis reg na mdzes pa yin no// zhes zer mod/ rtsod spong gi thag rul la yang lan gyi 'breng rul 'thud pa des snyan brgyud bzhi ldan gyi bla ma'i zhabs nas ma 'then par khong rang rnams ci bder bzhugs su gsol na phan yon che zhing*/

gan mdzod pa'i zhal gyi padma la reg par bzod pa'i zla zer ma dmigs pa'i khar/ rtsod spong nyi ma'i 'od zer gyis yang yang phye bas 'dab ma'i dkyil 'khor je rgyas su gyur pa 'di'o// ༈ rtsod spong gi sa bcad gnyis pa ni/ mdo lugs kyis 'tshang rgya bar khas blangs shing*/ zhes rtsod pa ni 'brel cung zad kyang mi 'byung ste/ mdo rang rkang la 'tshang rgya ba khas mi len zhing zer ba bris mod/ 'o na rab dbyer/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas lam po che// rtsod pa kun las grol ba'i chos// mkhas pa kun gyis gus pas bsten// ces mdo'i lam rim la bsngags pa brjod nas/ lam der zhugs nas rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas sgrub pa la 'di dang 'di bzhin gyis shig ces 'doms par bzhed nas/ 'on kyang theg pa chen po yi// sde snod rnams las 'byung ba bzhin// byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed la// grangs med gsum du tshogs gnyis gsogs// sems can yongs su smin pa dang*// sangs rgyas zhing rnams legs par sbyong*// sa bcu'i tha mar bdud btul nas// rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob par gsungs// zhes dang*/ so nam tshul bzhin byas pa yis// lo tog rim gyis smin pa ltar// pha rol phyin pa'i lam zhugs nas// grangs med gsum gyis rdzogs 'tshang rgya// zhes sogs kyi gzhung zhal gsal can bzhugs shing*/ de'i lugs 'dzin du'ang khas blangs nas/ slar yang mdo rang rkang gis 'tshang rgya ba khas mi len zer ba de ni/ 'gro ba'i bla ma'i gsung la brgal ba ste/ zhes pa der snang bas gang yang mi btub la/ rab dbye la mi rtsi na ni/ 'dod na de la ngas ci bya// zer ba der gda'o// ༈ yang rtsod spong du/ des khas blangs na yang*/ mdo rang rkang gi sangs rgyas kyi mkhyen pa de phyag chen ma yin pa'i phyir/ des na rtsod pa 'di ni lho 'di na stag mo las ma skyes pa'i stag phrug yod de/ byang pha gi na 'brong mo las skyes pa'i 'brong phrug yod pa'i phyir zhes pa ste/

dbang dang ma 'brel ba'i phyag chen yod de/ mdo rang rkang la brten nas sangs rgyas 'byung ba'i phyir/ zhes bkod pa de nyid kyis so// zhes smras so// mdo rang rkang nas 'tshang rgya ba yod par khyed rang gis bsgrubs nas/ de'i mkhyen pa'i ye shes de 'bras bu phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub ma yin na gzhan gang zhig yin/ thar pa zhes bya gcig pu nyid// mang po dmigs par mi 'gyur ro// zhes ma gsungs sam/ ngor rdzong gi 'dod lugs de ka yin srid kyang mi rtsod la/ rgyud dang sems 'grel sogs tshad thub kyi gzhung du mar/ phar phyin theg pa dang sngags kyi theg pa gnyis kyi lta ba dang 'bras bu la khyad par med pas don gcig pa dang*/ de rtogs byed kyi thabs la ma rmongs pa sogs kyis zab khyad zhugs pa yin ces 'byung ba de khyed rang yang 'dod mod/ mdo sngags kyi thob bya'i 'bras bu gcig pa de lta na/ sngags kyi 'bras bu de ni phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub yin par lhun gyis grub phyin de dang don gcig tu gyur pa'i mdo'i sangs rgyas kyi mkhyen pa de yang de ka'o// mdo sngags don gcig pa'i lung khyad du bsad nas/ mi gcig pa'i rigs pa ltar snang la 'chel ba de ni stag mo dang 'brong mo'i dpe don khyed rang la gnas pa kho na ste/ dus dang blo gros gron du gyur// kye ma sangs rgyas bstan pa ni// 'di ltar gyur pa da gzod go /zhes pa der gda'o// 'di rnams kyi mtha' dpyod brgal lan phyi ma dag gi skabs su gang bab bab tu brjod par bya'o// ༈ rtsod spong gi sa bcad gsum pa/ gzhi phyag rgya chen po yul ci nas mi thon/ zhes pa'i bsun 'byin yang ltar snang kho na ste/ gzhi phyag chen gyi tha snyad khas len du chug na yang*/ des phyag chen gyi go mi chod pa'i phyir ro// zhes pa la/ brtag gnyis kyi lung*/ ga bur nyid ni bdag med ma// bde ba bdag med tshul can nyid// de yi bde ba phyag rgya che// lte ba'i dkyil 'khor nyid du gnas// dang po'i dbyangs yig rang bzhin te// blo zhes sangs rgyas rnams kyis btags// zhes pa'i lung la 'dzems nas/

gzhi phyag rgya chen po'i tha snyad khas mi len rang yang zer ma nus/ des phyag chen gyi go chod rang byas na/ sngar gyi khas blangs la tho reg phog dogs nas g.yon lab byas par zad do// ༈ yang rtsod spong las/ des go chod na rang nyid la khas blangs nang 'gal 'byung ste/ rang gis phyag chen ngos 'dzin pa'i tshe/ drang don/ nges don/ mthar thug gsum du phye ba'i/ mthar thug de ka zhes dang*/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yang yin la/ bde dgyes dus 'khor sogs thams cad kyang yin pa skad gsungs pa dang*/ nā ro ta pa'i phyag rgya bzhi pa yin/ klu sgrub dang mai tri pa'i phyag chen dang*/ dam rgyar 'di'i phyag chen bsdus so zhes sogs bshad pa dang 'gal ba'i phyir te/ mthar lam gyi sne kha ma zin pa'i 'gro ba sems can gyi rgyud kyi gzhi dus kyi phyag chen de/ bde mchog kye rdor sogs su thal ba dang*/ de dag shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dngos su thal ba dang*/ de dag kyang phyag rgya bzhi gang rung gi nang tshan du thal lo// zhes bris mod/ rtsod spong mkhan po nyid dus phyis mtshan nyid kyi theg pa smra ba rnams kyi nang na mchog tu grags shing grub kyang*/ lam 'bras gsung phyir tshul chen mkhyen gyur pa// zhes pa bzhin gsung ngag rin po che'i nyan bshad yams se ba cig dang*/ rab dbye'i sngags sdom gyi thar thor 'di tsam ma gtogs sngags gzhung che ba rnams la bshad rkang ma tshugs pa'i stabs kyis/ rgyud sde las byung ba'i lta sgom gyi nges gsang sgrogs pa'i tshe/ nyan thos sde pa dang*/ theg chen gyi'ang drang don tsam la thugs kyi bag chags brtas pa'i gzhan dbang gis lham dpe zhwa la 'gegs phul ches so// de yang*/ rje pad dkar zhabs kyis/ khong mi tshe ring sbyangs pa'i mkhas pas kyang*// don yin lugs su bsnyad pa blos mi 'chun// ces gsungs pa ltar/ gsang ba'i gtam rgya chen po thugs su mi shong ba ni des lan to// gang ltar yang drang nges mthar thug gsum du bzhag pa'i phyi ma de/

phyag chen mchog gi dngos grub bam 'bras bu'i phyag chen/ de ka shes phyin/ bde kye gsang gsum sogs yin byas pa la 'gal ba gcig kyang med de/ dper na/ bde kye gsang 'dus sogs kyi rgyud kyi gleng gzhi gcig rang bzhin rkyen rnam 'gyur gyi sgo nas bshad na yig don/ bskyed rim mam las rab 'byams lta bur bkral na spyi don/ mtshan bcas kyi rdzogs rim mam thun mong gi dngos grub tu bkral na sbas don/ mchog gi dngos grub tu bkral na mthar thug ste/ de ltar byas tsa na/ tshig gcig la ni sna tshogs don// zhes rgyud las gsungs pa de 'ong*/ de las 'di mthar thug ltar bkral ba'i skabs yin pas mthar thug gi skyel sa gcig rang las med do// de ltar ma yin par bde mchog la brten nas sangs rgyas pa'i sangs rgyas de bde mchog gcig pu yin gyi gzhan gang yang ma yin gsungs na dpal ldan sa skya pa'i bstan pa la mi mdzes shing*/ zab gsal snyan brgyud la dkar ba'i bag chags sad ces pa'ang mi bden par 'gyur ro// de yang khyed kyis/ mthar lam gyi sne kha ma zin pa'i 'gro ba sems can zhes dma' dma' mo'i don spyi shar 'dug kyang*/ chos skad 'di tsam gyi skabs su/ sems can go 'phang dma' shos sam/ thabs brdugs shos sam/ go sa chung shos gcig gi rgyud la yod pa'i sems nyid rang bzhin gyis 'od gsal ba gzhi phyag rgya chen por bzhag pa de dang*/ 'bras bu mngon gyur gyi 'phags pa mchog gi thugs rgyud dri bral de la ngo bo'i sgo nas khyad par gcig kyang med pas/ rgyud las/ sems can rnams ni sangs rgyas nyid de sangs rgyas chen po gzhan ni 'jig rten khams na yod ma yin/ zhes dang*/ sems ni rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas nyid// ces dang*/ sangs rgyas rnams ni byung gyur tam// ma byung na yang rnam kun tu// bsam gyis mi khyab chos nyid ni// 'phel 'grib spangs pas gnas pa yin// ces dang*/

rin chen sems las phyir gyur pa'i// sangs rgyas med cing sems can med// ces sogs dang*/ sangs rgyas kun gyi sdom pa ni// e waṃ yi ge la rab gnas// sku dang gsung dang thugs kyi las// rnam kun mchog gi sdom pa'o// sdom pa byang chub bde mchog ste// ltar med brjod du med pa'o// zhes de ka bde mchog yin pa dang*/ sangs rgyas kun gyi gsang ba ni// 'dus pa bde ba'i mchog yin te// zhes gsang 'dus dang bde mchog don gcig pa sogs rgyud las ji snyed bshad pas blo chung ngur mi bya'o// de skad byas tsa na/ skabs 'dir bde kye sogs kyang bzhin lag gi rnam pa can de la blo rtse mi gtod par e waṃ zung 'jug thabs shes dbyer med de ka bde kye sogs yin la/ de'i tshe/ 'on kyang glo bur dri mas bsgribs// zhes pa la 'dzem mi dgos te/ sems kyi rang bzhin 'od gsal te// dri ma rnams ni glo bur ba// zhes lung tshad ma las bshad pa bzhin/ dri ma de gzhi la med kyang ma rig pas bslad pa dag la glo bur du snang gi de sel khyer yang kho rang gi rang bzhin yongs su shes pa tsam gyis chog pa/ dper na/ bden par go bas brdzun zhig pa lta bu zer rgyu yin/ de bzhin du nyon mongs sogs 'khor ba'i chos thams cad dang*/ ye shes sogs rnam byang gi chos thams cad la mtshungs par rgyud sde 'chad pa la mkhas pa'i shing rta chen po rnams kyis nges pa'i don 'di lta bu bshad pa la som nyi mdzad mi rung*// ༈ rtsod spong du/ shes rab pha rol phyin gnyis med// ces sogs kyi lung drangs nas/ gzhung lam sher phyin gyis sher phyin gyi go mi chod gsung ba la/ gzhi phyag rgya chen po kho na re/ de la nga la ni khyad par med zer gyin gda'o// de ltar du legs par bshad pa'i tshe/ sbas don yid bzhin gyi nor bus gang ba rgyal ba'i gan mdzod chen po ni dbyar mtsho ltar 'phel ba kho na'o// smra ba ngan pa'i rgyun dang legs bshad kyi// bdud rtsi mnyam du 'bab pa mi rigs zhes// rgyud mang sgra dang sbyar ba glu'i snyan 'gyur// mgrin pa'i sbubs nas dbyangs can dpal mos bsgrags// 'on te gtsang dang gtsang min chu bo kun// bstan bcos rgya mtshor lhung tshe ro gcig pa'i// dba' rlabs dkar po mkha' klong dang 'dres de'i// 'od kyis snying po'i bstan pa gsal zhing 'tsher// zhes kyang smras so//

༈ gan mdzod las/ rtog pa kha tshom nyid bsgom gyi// rim gnyis las byung ye shes la// phyag rgya chen por mi shes so// 'di yang mi rigs te/ 'khrul lugs phyag rgya chen po dgag pas so// de'i tha snyad khas mi len dgongs na/ sambu ṭir/ gti mug dam tshig phyag rgya che// zhe sdang rtag tu phyag rgya che// phrag dog las kyi phyag rgya che// 'dod chags chos kyi phyag rgya'o// phyag rgya de dag rnal 'byor pas// rdzogs par byed pa bsten par bya// zhes gsungs pa de ci red na/ zhes pa'i lan/ rtsod spong du/ 'di yang chu shing gi snying po dang mtshungs pa ste/ spyir phyag rgya bzhi po 'di ni sbyang bya nyon mongs bzhi dang sbyar ba/ smin byed dbang bzhi dang*/ dga' ba bzhi dang*/ tshad med bzhi dang*/ rnal 'byor bzhi dang*/ rten dkyil 'khor bzhi dang*/ 'bras bu sku bzhi dang sbyar ba sogs mang dag snang mod/ de dag la dngos btags chen po yod pa ma phye bar so so nas zhal gyis bzhes te/ 'khrul lugs phyag rgya chen por ming btags pa'i/ gti mug dam tshig phyag rgya che// zhes sogs kyi gti mug dam tshig gi phyag rgya yang yin pa dang zhe sdang phyag rgya chen po yang yin zhes so// de dag phyag chen mtshan nyid pa yin na ni ha cang thal ches/ min na ni gong gi bsun 'byin la 'brel mi 'byung ste/ phyag rgya chen po la dbang dang rim gnyis gang rung la ltos mi dgos pa'i phyir te/ gti mug dam tshig phyag rgya che// zhes sogs gsungs pa ltar nyon mongs pa bzhi la phyag rgya bzhir ming btags pa yod pa'i phyir/ zhes par song bas bde ba'i dga' ston kho na yin pa'i phyir ro// zhes bkod mod/ ci rtog pa kha tshom zhes pa rnam rtog lam khyer la zer na ni/ yid la ci yang mi bsam pa dwags po ba'i phyag chen yin zhes smra ba dang 'gal/ yang*/ rtog pa kha tshom ni rnam rtog 'gog pa yin la/ de sngags kyi phyag chen ma yin zer na ni/

phyag rgya chen po rnal du mtshon pa mchod rten drung thob las/ de nas blo 'phro na 'das pa'i rjes mi dpyad/ ma 'ongs pa'i rnam rtog byung na sdun mi bsu/ da lta'i rnam rtog byung na thug phrad yin te/ zhes sogs dang*/ lam zab bla mar/ sems gnad la dbab pa dus gsum gyi spros pa bcad nas mi rtog par bzhag go /zhes dang*/ phyag rgya chen po yi ge med par/ de la yi ge zhes bya ba rnam rtog yin/ brjod pa yin/ rnam rtog med cing brjod pa dang bral ba la phyag rgya chen po yi ge med pa zhes bya'o// zhes sogs gsungs pa dran par mdzad nas gzhan la smra bar ma rings shig yang*/ brtag pa'i mtha' de gnyis ma yin pa gzhan zhig ston rgyu yod na legs kyang*/ de med pa'i cha rgyus nga la yod do// gzhung 'di dang*/ gong du/ nged kyi phyag rgya chen po ni// sogs gsungs zin nas/ 'di yi rtogs pa gsang sngags kyi// thabs la mkhas na tshe 'dir 'grub// de las gzhan du phyag rgya che// rtogs par sangs rgyas kyis ma gsungs// des na phyag rgya chen po la// mos na gsang sngags gzhung bzhin bsgrubs// zhes lung bstan mdzad pa bka' drin che na'ang*/ des na nyan thos theg pa ni// nub kyang gzugs brnyan tsam zhig snang*// rdo rje theg pa'i bstan pa ni// gzugs brnyan tsam yang mi snang ngo*// zhes gsungs pa bden na/ sngags gzhung las bshad pa'i dbang*/ rim gnyis/ de dag las skyes pa'i ye shes sogs ji ltar sgrub ste/ rdo rje theg pa'i bstan pa ni gzugs brnyan tsam yang ma lus pa'i phyir snyam mo// 'khrul lugs phyag rgya chen po'i ming dang tha snyad la rtsal 'don mdzad mkhan rgyal ba yang dgon pa yin te khong gi gsung 'phros su/ ngas 'khrul lugs phyag rgya chen po 'di la go ba legs par thebs pas 'khor ba la khyur mid rgyab/ sangs rgyas la nyin khugs btang ba yin zhes gsungs 'dug khong chos rje pa rang gi dngos slob yin pas/

deng sang gi dge bshes pa tsho las thugs rgyus che bar khums so// de'i don yang*/ gsang sngags bla med kyi nyams len la brten nas gnas lugs kyi rang zhal gzigs pa'i rnal 'byor pa rnams kyi rjes thob tu/ sngon gyi bag chags tsho rnam rtog nyon mongs kyi gzugs brnyan du lhongs te ma 'gags pa'i 'char sgo ji snyed 'byung yang*/ de la tha mal pa bzhin rang gar mi spyod par/ rang bzhin yongs su shes pa'i nyams len gyi rtsal du khyer nas gzugs sku gnyis kyi rten 'brel de thog nas sgrig pa la de skad du bsnyad pa ste/ 'khrul pa ltar snang ba'i cha nas zhe sdang sogs nyon mongs/ rang bzhin shes pa'i cha nas me long lta bu'i ye shes sogs phyag chen/ gzhi mthun bsdus nas nyon mongs ye shes dang rnam rtog chos sku zer ba yin pas gsung rab kyi don la zhugs shing*/ nyams len gyi thog tu 'bab pa cig yin kyang*/ zhar ba'i mthong ba can kha cig gi kha phyir mkhas pa rnams kyang 'brangs nas smra sgo mang po bye ba 'di ni/ khyi rgan ku co 'don pa la// rgyu mtshan med par gzhan dag rgyug /gsung ba de khar snang ngo*// 'khrul lugs phyag chen de la dkar brgyud pa rnams rnal 'byor bzhi'i nang tshan gyi ro gcig zer la/ de lta bu'i gnad ma go bar sngags bla med kyi nyams len byed rgyu'i khul gyis smin ru zing zing mdzad kyang*/ spang gnyen gyi 'dzin pa ma btang bas sngags bla med kyi dri mi mnam zhing ro mi bro'o// de ltar gsang sngags rgyu 'bras lhun grub tu nyams su len pa'i gnad zur tsam kha las shor ba 'di/ mi shes pa'am rmongs pa la// tshul chen bstan par mi bya'o// zhes pa'i nyes par ma gyur cig/ ༈ de'i phyir rtsod spong du/ mdor na/ phyag chen ye shes dbang rim gang rung la ltos dgos par khas blangs pa la 'khrul lugs phyag chen skyon la gtong bar snang ste/ rtags ma grub ces pa gcig pus chog go

/zhes bkod mod/ de mtshams nas rgol bas kha rog sdod rogs byas na lta de khas 'thus shes kha ste/ dkar brgyud pa tsho slar yang gang zer sus shes/ des na rtags ma grub rkyang pa rang la ma ltos pa'i lan 'dra yang grabs su btsud na legs so// ༈ yang gan mdzod las/ blun pos phyag rgya che sgom pa// phal cher dud 'gro'i rgyu ru 'gyur// sogs ni phyogs chos rang gis ma gzigs par gzhan la ston pa'i ngag tu 'dug pas/ grangs can gyi ring lugs 'dzin rgyu lags grang*/ ring lugs de rnam 'grel du/ bdag mthong min yang gzhan dag gi mthong ba sgrub byed ces kha cig /ces sogs kyis bkag zin to// bdag nyid kyis mthong ngo zhes na/ rang nyid la gnod par 'gyur te/ phyag rgya chen po dbang bzhi pa thob nas ston rgyu/ de'i gdul bya ni dbang po rnon por nges pas so// zhes pa'i lan rtsod spong du/ mgo bsgre'i lan dang*/ rnal ma'i lan no// dang po ni/ bsun 'byin de lta bus ni 'phags pa klu sgrub kyang bsun 'byin par snang ngo*// ji ltar snyam na/ klu sgrub kyis/ stong pa nyid la lta nyes na// shes rab chung rnams phung bar 'gyur// ji ltar sbrul la gzung nyes dang*// rig sngags log par bsgrubs pa bzhin// zhes pa 'di yang*/ phyogs chos rang gis ma gzigs par gzhan la ston pa'i ngag tu 'dug pas grangs can gyi ring lugs so// phyogs chos rang gis gzigs na rang la gnod par 'gyur te// stong pa nyid la lta ba'i lta ba ni lta ba rnam dag yin pa dang*/ de ston yul gyi gdul bya de yang*/ zab mo 'khu 'khrig can 'jig pa dang*/ stong nyid snying rje'i snying po can// byang chub sgrub pa kha cig la'o// zhes dang*/ so so skye bo'i dus na'ang stong pa nyid thos nas// nang du rab tu dga' ba yang dang yang du 'byung*// zhes sogs ltar dbang rnon du nges pas so/ zhes mtshungs so// ci ste mi mtshungs te/ stong pa nyid la lta nyes na skyon der 'gyur zhes pa'i don yin pa'i phyir snyam na/

kho bo cag kyang de skad smra ste/ rim gnyis las byung ye shes la// phyag rgya chen por mi shes so// zhes dang*/ gal te de ni sgom legs kyang*// dbu ma'i sgom las lhag pa med// ces sogs kyi nus pa dang*/ blun po zhes pa'i tshig gi nus pas/ phyag rgya chen po sgom nyes pa dang*/ sgom ma shes na skyon der 'gyur zhes bshad pa'i phyir/ bskal bar mtshungs so// de bzhin du klu sgrub kyis/ rgyal ba kun gyis stong pa nyid// lta kun nges par 'byin par gsungs// gang dag stong pa nyid lta ba// de dag sgrub tu med par gsungs// zhes pa 'di yang bsun dbyung bar song bas/ 'jigs shing g.yang za ba'i bsun 'byin du snang ngo*// zhes bris so// de'i lan la'ang gnyis te/ mgo bsgre dang rnal lan no// dang po ni/ blun pos phyag rgya che bsgoms pa// sogs kyi gzhung 'dis ni 'jig rten dang bstan bcos la grags pa'i rgyu 'bras kyang bsun 'byin par snang ngo*// ji ltar snyam na/ blun pos nas kyi son btab pas// phal cher bra bo'i rgyu ru 'gyur// yang na sran ma nag por lhung*// min na gro yi 'bras bur smin// gal te de ni skye legs kyang*// sā lu'i 'bru las lhag pa med// sā lu'i 'bru de bzang mod kyi// 'on kyang 'grub pa shin tu dka'// zhes pa dang dpe don bskal bar mtshungs so// khyed kyis mgo bsgre mdzad pa de ni/ mi 'gre bzhin du nan gyis bsgres pa ste/ blun pos phyag chen bsgom pa'i rgyu gcig pu las 'bras bu dud 'gro'am/ gzugs med dam/ 'gog pa'am/ dbu ma'i sgom gang rung 'byung ba ste/ rgyu gcig las 'bras bu rigs mi 'dra ba bzhi 'byung bar bshad la/ khyed kyis dper bkod pa de la/ stong pa nyid la blta ma shes na shes rab chung ba rnams phung zhes pa tsam las ma byung bas/ rgyu gcig las 'bras bu rigs gcig pa 'byung ba ni mchog tu'ang bden la/

klu sgrub kyi gzhung phyi ma'ang de dang mtshungs pas mgo mi 'gre'o// des na 'jigs shing g.yang za ba de yang*/ 'brog pa thang skam po la bsdad yun ring pas stong nyid kyi g.yang sa chen po mthong nas 'jigs pa ni mad na/ gzung 'dzin gyi phyag des sngar bzhin dam du 'jus shig rnal mar gsol te/ sdom gsum gyi gzhung de lta bu dgongs pa can du 'grel ma mkhyen na kha na ma tho bas reg par 'gyur ro// ji ltar 'grel zhe na/ dgongs pa can du bsgrub pa la dgongs gzhi/ dgos pa/ dngos la gnod byed gsum 'god dgos pa'i dgongs gzhi ni/ spyir gang zag dbang brtul/ phar phyin theg pa lugs kyi lta ba la thos bsam gyi sbyangs pa ma byas shing*/ sngags kyi skor dbang lta ci/ sta gon tsam yang zhu ma myong ba zhig la/ mi shes bzhin du khrid 'chad pa la rings pa'i sgam sgom gyi bla ma 'ga' zhig gis/ phyag chen gyi khrid the tshom tsam yang med par 'chad kyi 'dug mod/ rgyud ma sbyangs pa'i gang zag de ni blun po las 'os ci yod/ des rnam par mi rtog pa'i sems gnas sgrub pa'i tshe dran shes kyis ma zin pa'i mi rtog had po lung ma bstan de phyag chen du rloms nas rgyun bsrings pa na dud 'gro'i rgyu ru 'gro ste/ blun po de'i rgyud kyi mi rtog pa'i sems byung de ni rig pa'i mi mthun phyogs ma rig pa yin pas so// ma rig pa la'ang*/ nyon mongs can yin min gnyis las 'di phyi ma/ de la'ang las 'bras dang de kho na nyid la rmongs pa'i ma rig pa gnyis las 'di phyi mar 'dus la/ des kun nas blangs pa'i las ni gtso bor dud 'gro 'grub byed du gsungs te/ rmongs pa phal cher dud 'gror 'gro// zhes so// des na dug gsum dang mtshungs ldan gyi las so so ba dag ngan song 'grub byed du 'chad pa'i phyir snyam du dgongs so// de bzhin du rdzogs smin sbyang gsum ma byas par yang dag mtha' mngon du byas na chad pa'i myang 'das su lhung zhes pa dang*/

so sor rtog pa'i shes rab kyis ma zin pa'i 'du shes rags pa la skyon du lta ba'i sgom de ni gzugs med khams kyi rgyu'o zhes pa lta bu dgongs gzhi/ de lta bu la mun sgom byed pa'i log rtog 'gog pa dgos pa/ phyag rgya chen po sgom pas 'khor ba mtho dman de dag tu mi 'ching zhing grol ba'i thabs mchog tu 'gyur bar ston pa'i lung bsam gyis mi khyab pa rnams ni dngos la gnod byed du bkod nas 'chad shes na legs po 'ong ste dka' ba 'dra/ de lta bu'i go ba ma chags par gzhung de 'chad blo byas na/ rdo rje snying 'grel las/ rgyu 'dra de las skye ba yi// 'bras bu thams cad du mthong gi /ko ṭa pa yi sa bon las// sā lu'i 'bru ni 'byung ba med// ces sogs dang*/ chos kyi dbyings su bstod pa las kyang*/ de 'dra'i sa bon thams cad las// rgyu dang 'dra ba'i 'bras bu 'byung*// zhes sogs lung rigs rgya mtsho tsam dang 'gal bar 'gyur te/ dud 'gro'i rgyu dang*/ 'gog pa'i rgyu dang*/ gzugs med khams kyi rgyu rnams skyid sdug gcig tu btang ba de/ stabs legs na dbu ma'i sgom du 'gro zer bar song 'dug pas de 'dra la 'brel ci zhig yod/ de'i phyir/ bdag mthong min yang sogs bkod pa de ni/ sa lo mkhas pa chen po des/ log pa de 'dra mi gzigs kyang*/ gzhan 'ga' zer ro zhe na/ de mi bden te/ gtan tshigs rnam dag med pa'i phyir ro// zhes 'phral du sa paṇa 'gog pa ltar snang yang*/ don du g.yas 'jog mdzad pa'o// gal te kho bo rang gis mthong gsung na/ 'o na khyed rang gi gzhung las/ dbang bskur bzhi pa ma thob par// phyag rgya chen po sogs sgom dang*// zhes bkag nas rang lugs phyag chen dbang bzhi pa thob nas bsgom dgos la/ sgom mkhan de ni dbang rnon du khas blangs pa'i phyir ro// zhes phyogs snga 'gog pa dang*/ rang lugs sgrub pa tshig rim pa gcig gis bstan to// de ltar ma bshad pa/

gnod byed 'di yang so na gnas te/ 'o na blun pos phyag chen bsgom pa dud 'gro'i rgyur 'gro ba'i lung tshad ma gang yin/ de dud 'gror 'phen byed dang 'grub byed kyi las gang du 'dod/ phyag chen gyi lta ba de nyon mongs par 'dod dam/ des kun nas blangs pa'i las gang du 'dod/ dbu ma'i lta ba de las dang nyon mongs pa gang rung du khas blangs na skyon ci yod/ zhes sogs glengs na dbu snyung bar 'gyur ro// rtsod spong du dngos lan kyang des 'thus mod ces bkod pa bzhin /lan 'debs kyang zhib rgyas song ba yin la/ dpyad pa gsum mdzad pa'i don yang kho bos smras pa de khar tshang ngo*// 'on kyang rang gzhan gyi gzhung gang la yang ma 'dris kyang*/ kun slong kho na la rtsa slob mdzad pa dag gis/ blun pos phyag rgya che sgom pa// sogs kyi lung 'di khyi'i nor bzhin kha rang du khyer nas/ chos spong gi sgrub thabs nyams su len pa rnams la snying brtse ba'i lhag bsam gyis 'di bri bar bya ste/ blun pos phyag chen bsgom pa dud 'gro sogs kyi rgyur 'gro ba de/ bsgom bya chos kyi skyon yin nam/ sgom mkhan gang zag gi skyon yin/ dang po ltar na/ blun po zer ci dgos te/ de 'dra'i chos de mkhas pas sgom na'ang dud 'gro'i rgyur mi 'gyur ba'i rgyu mtshan gang yin/ yang gang zag gi skyon yin zer na/ blun pos lam 'bras sgom pa yang*// phal cher dud 'gro'i rgyu ru 'gyur// zhes bzlog ste smra na ci gsung*/ gal te de ni phyag chen ngos ma zin pa la phyag chen gyi ming btags pa de bsgom pas dud 'gror skye ba'i rgyu byed pa la bsams nas smras so zhe na/ blun pos phyag chen ma yin pa la yin par bsgom pa skyon chung gi rang nyid mkhas par khas blangs nas phyag chen ma yin pa la phyag chen du ming btags nas bod pa 'di 'chal lo// de ltar na/ blun pos phyag chen min bsgom pa// zhes thog mar 'gyur bcos byas la/

de nas brtsad par bya yi/ gzhan du 'brel mi 'byung ngo*// yang gal te nged cag ni blun po 'ga' zhig lam 'bras kyi khrid la 'jug pa'i tshe 'di ltar du byed de/ ngor lugs gzhir bzhag nas/ thog mar snang ba gsum gyi sgo nas thun mong theg pas rgyud sbyangs/ bar du byang chub chen por sems bskyed/ de nas rgyu dbang gis smin pa la 'khor 'das dbyer med kyi lta ba brda' sprod pa sogs kyi sgo nas rim gyis gzhug go zhe na/ nged dwags po'i dkar brgyud ngo ma lhad ma zhugs shing 'dres ma khyer ba rnams kyis kyang*/ dad brtson dang ldan pa'i slob ma phyag rgya chen po'i lam du rim gyis 'khrid pa na thun mong gi sngon 'gro skyes bu chung 'bring gi lam gyis rgyud sbyangs/ thun mong ma yin pa'i sngon 'gro bzhi sbyor gyis skyes bu chen po'i lam du smin par byas/ 'dod sems rtse gcig pa'i ting nge 'dzin las su rung ba las skyes pa'i so sor rtog pa'i shes rab kyi mes dngos por 'dzin pa'i bud shing thams cad bsregs nas/ chos thams cad shin tu mnyam pa nyid kyi ting nge 'dzin zung 'jug chen po'i go 'phang la 'god par mdzad pa yin pas chos bzhin du sus kyang klan ka byar med do// ༈ gan mdzod las/ gnyis pa ma nor ba dkar brgyud pas bstan tshul la/ phyag rgya'i rnam grangs las gang yin pa/ phyag chen de rang gi ngo bo ci lta bu yin pa/ nges tshig mdo rgyud gnyis kar bstan tshul/ de dkar po chig thub tu 'gro ba'i gnad bshad pa dang bzhi las/ dang po ni/ jo bo nā ro ta pas gsungs pa'i phyag rgya bzhi pa de'i nang gi 'di phyag rgya bzhi par 'ong ste/ phyag rgya dang po phyi rol gyi bud med/ gnyis pa yid kyi rig ma/ gsum pa phyag rgya chen po'am chen mo rnam kun mchog ldan gyi stong nyid la mdzad pas/ dus kyi 'khor lo nas gsungs pa'i phyag rgya bzhi ji lta ba/ slob dpon chen po klu sgrub dang*/

rgyal ba mai tri pas gsungs pa'i phyag chen dang dam rgyar 'di'i phyag rgya chen po bsdus so// rgyud rdo rje 'phreng bar/ chos dang las dang dam tshig dang*// phyag rgya chen por mngon par brjod// zhes sogs bgrangs nas/ de bas na phyag rgya chen po zhes pa'i sgra tsam la rnam par phye ba mang yang*/ 'dir bstan chags lam dang gnyis su dbye ba'i dus kyi grol lam de'o// zhes bka' stsal pa la rtsod spong du/ 'o na rgyud sde 'og ma rang rkang gi phyag chen dang*/ mdo rang rkang gi phyag chen sogs kyang 'di'i phyag rgya bzhi'i phyag chen sogs su 'dus sam ma 'dus/ 'dus na 'di skabs kyi phyag rgya bzhi ni bla med dbang las rnyed dgos par ye shes thig le'i rgyud las bsgrubs zin pas gnod/ mi 'du na ji skad bshad pa de ni dngos btags rnam par ma phye ba'i gsung du snang bas dngos btags phye nas smra bar rigs so// zhes bris pa ni/ sa bcad 'dzin pa'i tho yor gyi gzugs brnyan nam/ sngar zos zin pa'i skyugs bldad tsam du zad pa yin la/ 'on kyang ye shes snying po dang*/ ye shes thig le nor ba tsam 'dir lhag po'o// ༈ gan mdzod snga ma de'i 'phros las/ de yang dbu ma pas bdag bzlog pa dang sogs rgyas par gsungs pa'i lan rtsod spong du/ 'di dag phal cher snying gi bcud du gyur ba ltar snang mod/ dpyad par bya ba'i gnas kyang cung zad snang ste/ de yang gnas skabs gnyis par rnam rtog chos skur bzhed pa mi 'thad de/ byang 'phags kyi mnyam bzhag na gnyis snang med pa dang*/ rjes thob kyi gnyis snang kun rdzob tsam du bshad pa'i phyir/ sangs rgyas sar rnam rtog chos skur khas mi len pa yang khas blangs 'gal te/ sangs rgyas kyi gzigs pa tshad mar byas nas rnam rtog chos skur bzhed ces rnam rtog chos sku'i dris lan du bris snang ba'i phyir ro// zhes pa la/ 'dir gnas skabs gnyis par rnam rtog chos skur bzhag

dris lan du sangs rgyas kyi gzigs pa la der bzhag pa gnyis ma mthun pa ltar snang ba bden mod/ grub mtha' la gsar zhugs kyi blo gros ma smin pa la de 'dra'i dogs pa skye srid kyang*/ mkhas dbang khyed kyis mkhyen bzhin du bdag cag la co 'dri kho nar gsungs so// de la 'di zhu ste/ gnas skabs gsum du phye ba'i tshe/ byang 'phags dang*/ sangs 'phags so sor byas pa'i byang 'phags kyi rjes thob ye shes de rnam rtog chos skur bzhag 'di skabs kyi rnam rtog ces pa'ang sgra don 'dres rung kho na min par kun rdzob kyi phyogs thams cad la 'jog pas/ byang 'phags de'i rjes thob kun rdzob sgyu ma tsam du snang ba'i rnam rtog de ka'i rang bzhin chos skur bzhugs pa la bsams nas rnam rtog chos sku/ dris lan du byang 'phags yar bsdus nas sangs rgyas kyi gzigs ngor rnam rtog chos sku zhes gtam du mdzad pa'i rgyu mtshan mtha' dpyod 'og tu 'chad do// skabs gsum du 'jog pa 'di shin tu legs pa yin te/ dpal mgon klu sgrub kyis/ bdag go zhes kyang gdags gyur cing*// bdag med ces kyang bstan par gyur// sangs rgyas rnams kyis bdag dang ni// bdag med 'ga' med ces kyang bstan/ ces dang*/ de bzhin du/ bsod nams ma yin dang por zlog /bar du bdag ni zlog pa ste// tha mar lta zhig kun zlog pa// zhes dang*/ phyir mi ldog pa 'khor lo'i mdor/ yid bzhin gyi nor bu sbyong ba'i tshul gsum gyis bde bar gshegs pa'i snying po sbyang ba'i rim pa gsum bstan pa dang*/ dus 'khor du/ bsod nams kyi tshogs/ tshul khrims kyi tshogs/ ye shes kyi tshogs gsum la bkri ba'i rim pas dang*/ mnga' bdag mai tri pa dang*/ rje mar pa'i bzhed srol/ rje btsun gyis bskyar ba las/ skyes mchog mar pas 'di skad gsungs// phyi snang ba ji ltar snang lags kyang*// ma rtogs dus na 'khrul pa ste// phyi yul gyi snang bas 'ching bar byed// rtogs pa rnams la sgyu mar snang*// yul snang sems kyi grogs su 'char// mthar thug don la snang ma myong*// skye med chos skur dag go gsung*// nang 'gyu ba yid kyi rnam shes 'di// ma rtogs dus na ma rig pa// las nyon mongs kun gyi gzhi rtsa byed// rtogs na rang rig ye shes te// dkar po'i yon tan rdzogs par 'byung*// mthar thug don la ye shes med// chos rnams zad sar 'khyol lo gsung*// nyer len gzugs kyi phung po 'di// ma rtogs dus na 'byung bzhi'i lus// na tsha sdug bsngal de las 'byung*// rtogs na lha sku zung 'jug ste// tha mal zhen pa zlog par byed// mthar thug don la lus med de// sprin bral mkha' ltar dag go gsung*// zhes phyi snang ba/

nang rig pa/ nyer len phung po dang bcas pa skabs gsum gsum du bzhag la/ gan mdzod du tshig sna bsdu bar mdzad do// de gsum la ma rtogs pa'i skabs/ rtogs pa shar ba'i skabs/ mthar thug pa'i skabs gsum/ de yang so skye'i gnas skabs/ byang 'phags kyi gnas skabs/ sangs 'phags kyi gnas skabs dang gsum du shes par bya ste/ byams mgon gyis/ khams ni gnas skabs gsum dag tu// ming gsum gyis ni bstan pa yin// zhes dang*/ so so skye bos phyin ci log /bden pa mthong bas ldog pa ste// de bzhin gshegs pas ji lta bzhin// zhes dang*/ ma dag ma dag dag pa dang*// shin tu rnam dag go rim bzhin// sems can byang chub sems dpa' dang*// de bzhin gshegs pa nyid yin no// zhes sogs mang du gsungs pas gnas skabs gsum du dbye ba la klan ka bya bar mi rigs so// ༈ de la rtsod spong du/ gnas skabs dang po der bden gnyis dang 'khrul ma 'khrul sogs tha dad so sor khas len/ gnas skabs gnyis pa 'dir bden gnyis dbyer med dang*/ thabs shes dbyer med sogs khas len gsung ba ni/ rnam dpyod cher mi snang ste/ theg chen skabs su bden gnyis kyi rnam gzhag khas len byed pa de srid du/ bden pa gnyis dbyer med du khas len dgos shing de khas blangs kyang kun rdzob bden pa kun rdzob bden pa/ 'khrul pa 'khrul pa yin pa sogs rnam dbye ma 'chol bar khas len dgos pa'i phyir ro// zhes pa la/ theg chen gyi skabs zhes spom yor mdzad na mi 'thus pa'i rgyu mtshan/ theg chen so skye de skabs dang po ltar khas len dgos te/ ma rtogs pa'i skabs yin pa'i phyir/ gan mdzod du/ dang po la ni gnyis med dam zung 'jug ji tsam bshad kyang*/ blo'i go phyogs la gnyis snang ngam tha dad zhig ka 'byung ste don gnyis snang ma spangs pas lan/ de dag gi blo ngo bzung nas/ 'khrul pa 'khrul pa/ ma 'khrul pa ma 'khrul pa/ kun rdzob kun rdzob/

don dam don dam rang ste phan tshun 'gal ba lta bur bshad pa rnams bzung bas drang don/ blo dman rnams la de ka bden par bshad dgos pa yin no// zhes pa theg chen so skye kho rang 'bel gtam gyi grub mtha'i babs dang bstun pa'i khas len ji 'dra zhig byed kyang 'dra/ rang gi zhe 'dod dam rgyud thog na gnyis chos thams cad tha dad du yod pa de ka bde ba/ deng sang gi dge bshes rnams dbu ma'i chos skad mdzad pa lta bu/ bden gnyis dbyer med du khas len gsung ba'ang bden pa gnyis nyi ma dang nyi 'od bzhin 'bral mi shes pa zhig kho rang gi babs la 'dug pa la bsams na rung ba tsam ste/ de skabs su de gnyis mi 'bral yang*/ nyi ma ni 'di'o// nyi 'od ni 'di'o zhes so sor ngos 'dzin rgyu byung bas so// de dang 'dra bar 'khrul ma 'khrul sogs kyang ma 'chol bar khas len pa bden no// dkar brgyud rin po che'i lugs kyis/ de lta bu la bden gnyis zung 'brel zer gyi/ bden gnyis dbyer med dang zung 'jug sogs kyi sgra mi 'dogs/ de kas kho so skyer lus pa lags// ༈ gan mdzod du/ gnas skabs gnyis pa 'dir/ gnyis snang thams cad zad pas na gnyis med rtogs pa zhes bzhag de'i dbang gis rnam rtog thams cad chos sku/ nyon mongs thams cad bdud rtsi/ 'khrul pa thams cad ye shes su 'char bas/ phyogs su phye yang bye ba mi srid pas bden gnyis dbyer med/ thabs shes dbyer med sogs kyi gnad kas bden pa gcig ste don dam pa'i bden pa'o// zhes pa la rtsod spong du/ sgom mnyam 'jog pa dag de ltar gsungs pa la 'khrul gzhi snang yang mkhas pa'i gtam ma yin te/ zhes gsungs ba 'di ni shin tu tha chad pa'i tshig yin pas mkhas pa'i zhal las rgyu bar ci ste rigs/ rgyu mtshan yang dag pa'i mkhas pa ni nang du yang dag par mnyam par bzhag pa las byung ba'i de kho na nyid kyi don mngon sum du mdzad pa la zer bas/

chos rje pas/ mkhas gang shes bya'i de kho na// ji bzhin rtogs pa yin par 'dod// ces gsungs/ des na mkhas pa dang sgom chen lhan cig mi gnas pa'i 'gal ba lta bur mi bsam mo// mdor na/ mkhas pa khyed kyis/ rtsod spong du/ bskyed rdzogs sgom pa'i sngon du smin byed dbang bskur dgos pa'i lung rigs phung por spungs kyang*/ lung rigs smra ba po nyid dbang gis ma smin pa'i kha bun la zab mo'i gtam thugs su ma shong ba'i gsung mang zhig byon pa 'di ni zab mos 'jigs nas ma smin pa zhes 'phags yul ba'i grub thob kyis bsgrags pa de'o// ci ste nged kyis dbang thob cing smin no zhe na/ de ni/ gtor dang blugs pa zhes bya 'dis// des na dbang zhes brjod par bya// zhes pa'i don tshang ba'i dbang ma yin kyang*/ re zhig bskyed rim tsam nyan pa'i snod du rung ba ste/ grub thob gling gi mgur du/ cho ga mkhas pas dbang bskur kyang*// snod du rung tsam ma gtogs pa// ye shes skye la phan rgyu chung*// bla ma'i byin rlabs gtsigs su che// gsung ba der gda' bas deng phyin chad dbang bskur mu bzhir rtsi ba la 'phyas ma 'dogs shig gal te de ltar du gsung ba ni/ sgom mnyam 'jog pa ltar tshul 'chos pa/ dge slong lha chen po'i brtul zhugs la gzhol ba 'ga' la dgongs pa zhig na/ cung zad mad kyang*/ blun po de lta bu'i blo gros kyi mthus nges don gyi gtam chen po smra bar mi spobs kyi/ myong ba can 'dra'i tshig sgum btus pa yin la rag go/ ༈ rtsod spong du/ rnam rtog chos sku yin na rnam rtog kyang yin chos sku yang yin pa'i gzhi mthun zhig khas len dgos pa la/ de 'dra de gnas skabs gsum po gang du yang mi srid pa'i phyir dang*/ zhes pa'i lan mchan bur/ byams chos ne'u tsho'i 'don pa byed pa dag /mdo sde rgyan gyi/ de bzhin nyid dmigs ye shes ni// rnam pa tha dad med bsgom zhing*// yod dang med don mngon gsum pa// rnam rtog dbang 'byor nyid ces bya// 'grel par rnam pa tha dad med ces sogs drangs nas 'di la gzigs 'tshal lo// zhes gsungs pa'i yang lan du/

rtsa 'grel la 'bru gnon rgyas par mdzad pa'i mjug sdoms su/ chos nyid 'di rtogs pa'i mnyam bzhag tu gzhan dbang rnam rtog gi snang ba nub cing*/ rjes thob tu lta ba des zin pas snang ba rmi lam sgyu ma ltar 'char bas rnam par rtog pa la dbang 'byor zhes pa'i gnad kyang de yin/ zhes bris pa 'dis nged kyi 'dod pa bsgrubs so// ci'i phyir na byang 'phags kyi mnyam bzhag na rnam rtog yod zer mkhan mi snang zhing*/ rjes thob tu lta bas zin pa'i snang ba rmi lam sgyu ma lta bu de ka rnam rtog dbang 'byor gyi chos sku yin zhes nged kyis smras pa der song ste/ rnam rtog chos sku'i tha snyad byang 'phags kyi rjes thob ye shes la byas pa yin tshul mang du bshad zin pa dang mthun pa'i phyir ro// des na bdag pas gzhan gces sgom pa bka' drin che// ༈ yang rtsod spong du/ rnam rtog rang yal du song ba la chos sku'i ming 'dogs na ni/ ming la mi rtsod mod/ don dang ming mi mthun pa'i phyir te/ sprin nam mkhar dwangs pa'i tshe sprin nam mkha' yin ces smra ba dang mtshungs pa'i phyir ro// zhes pa'i thal 'gyur 'di ni/ khas len med pa'i thal 'gyur 'phen pa yi// 'phags chen rnams kyi rigs pa 'di la gzigs// gsung ba dang 'dra bas lan gyi rnam g.yeng ma dgos la/ ming la mi rtsod gsung ba mi bden te/ rnam rtog chos sku'i ming de ka thugs su ma shong bas lan to// lar ming thams cad la gzhi mthun dgos na/ bya rgod gshongs la bya rgod kyang yin la gshongs kyang yin pa'i gzhi mthun su zhig gis bzo dgongs shig de'i phyir/ rnam rtog chos sku'i gtam gsan sngangs skad pa// bden na blo gros rnam rgyal gang gis 'grub// ces pa der snang ngo*// nyid dpal ldan sa skya pa'i bstan 'dzin chen po yin pas/ rang byung ye shes skye ba la// rnam rtog nyid kyang ye shes su// bsgoms dang ma bsgoms khyad par med// ces bla ma sa skya pa chen pos gsungs pa'i rjes su 'jug par rigs kyi/

rnam shes 'di ni chos sku'i mi mthun phyogs// yin phyir chos sku gtan nas ma yin no// zhes smra ba'i rjes su rnam pa thams cad du 'jug pa ga la rigs/ gnas skabs gnyis par gnyis 'dzin ma spangs pa'i ngor/ gnyis med kyi gtam ji tsam bshad kyang*/ tha dad der 'dzin gyi blo ro ldang ba zhig 'dug kyang*/ gal po che la lan gsum gyi dper 'dug pa dang*/ de yang*/ yid ches tshig ni mi bslu ba// zhes pa ltar lung tshad mas bsgrub par bya ste/ de la thog mar brda' chad la bslab dgos pas/ rtog pa dang*/ rnam par rtog pa dang*/ kun tu rtog pa ste/ 'khor bar 'phen byed dang*/ 'khor ba skyed byed dang*/ 'khor bar 'ching byed zhes bya ba/ don du/ kun rdzob kyi phyogs thams cad rnam rtog yin pa la dgongs nas/ rnam rtog nyon mongs/ dri ma/ 'dus byas/ mdangs/ 'khor ba/ srid pa/ ma rig pa/ snang ba/ rnam pa sogs kun nas nyon mongs pa'i phyogs su gtogs so cog de bzhin du/ chos sku/ chos nyid/ chos dbyings/ rang bzhin/ 'dus ma byas/ myang 'das/ sangs rgyas/ byang chub ces sogs rnam par byang ba'i phyogs thams cad/ de dag phan tshun rnam dbyer med par ro mnyam du thugs nyams su bstar zhing*/ skal ba bzang po dag la legs par 'doms pa ni snying po'i don gyi bstan 'dzin yin nges shes pa dpal dwags po'i dkar brgyud ces yongs su grags pa 'di nyid kyi khyad chos bla na med pa'o// de ltar yang*/ 'phags pa dad pa'i stobs bskyed pa la 'jug pa'i phyag rgya zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo las/ 'jam dpal/ gzhan yang dbugs 'byin pa rnyed pa lnga dag byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi sa dang po'i yongs sbyong du 'gyur te/ lnga gang zhes na 'di lta ste/ bdag ni ma rig pa dang dbyer med pa'i rig pa shes pa la gnas kyi/ gzhan dag kyang ma rig pa dang dbyer med pa'i rig pa shes pa la 'god do// zhes dbugs 'byin pa rnyed par 'gyur te/

de la ma rig pa dang dbyer med pa'i rig pa ni ma rig pa'i rang bzhin gang yin pa'o// de ci'i phyir zhe na/ rig pa ni ma rig pa'i rang bzhin las gzhan ma yin pa'i phyir te/ ma rig pa'i rang bzhin las rig pa gzhan med pas ma rig pa'i rang bzhin nyid rig pa ste/ ma rig pa'i rang bzhin gyi rig pa shes pa des/ chos thams cad rig pa'o// zhes pa ltar/ 'dod chags/ zhe sdang*/ gti mug nying mtshams sbyor ba sogs la 'gres rkang sbyor ba dang*/ slar yang 'dus byas dang dbyer med pa 'dus ma byas pa ni/ 'dus byas kyi rang bzhin gang yin pa'o// de ci'i phyir zhe na/ zhes sogs kyi 'phros/ dngos po dngos med/ 'khor 'das/ yod med la sogs pa kun rigs 'grer gsungs shing*/ 'od srungs kyis zhus pa'i mdo las/ 'od srungs rig pa dang ma rig pa de dag gnyis ma yin zhing*/ rnam pa gnyis su dbyer med pa'o// 'od srung 'di ltar shes pa gang yin pa de ni dbu ma'i lam chos rnams la yang dag par so sor rtog pa zhes bya'o// de bzhin du/ 'du byed rnams dang*/ 'dus ma byas dang*/ rnam par shes pa dang*/ rnam par shes pa 'gag pa dang*/ ming dang gzugs dang*/ ming dang gzugs 'gag pa dang*/ zhes pa nas/ rga shi dang rga shi 'gag pa de dag gnyis ma yin zhing rnam pa gnyis su dbyer med de/ 'od srungs/ de ltar shes pa gang yin pa de ni dbu ma'i lam chos rnams la yang dag par so sor rtog pa shes bya'o// zhes gsungs so// de'i phyir gnas lugs kyi don de la/ dri mas gos pa ltar snang yang*/ dri ma gdod ma nas yod ma myong bas ye dag yin pa'i phyir/ gnyen pos bsal bya med pas na gzungs dbang gis zhus pa'i mdor/ zad pa gnyen pos zad pa ma yin te// sngon nas zad pas de phyir zad ces bstan// ces dang*/ chos dbyings bstod par yang*/ dus rnam kun tu nyon mongs med// thog ma dbus mthar dri ma bral// zhes dang*/ rgyal tshab chen pos kyang*/

nyes pa glo bur dang ldan zhing*// yon tan rang bzhin nyid ldan phyir// ji ltar sngar bzhin phyis de bzhin// 'gyur ba med pa'i chos nyid do// zhes so// mngon rtogs rgyan dang rgyud bla gnyis ka tshig mthun par/ 'di la bsal bya ci yang med// bzhag par bya ba cung zad med// yang dag nyid la yang dag blta// yang dag mthong na rnam par grol// zhes 'byung mod/ de'i dgongs pa 'grel tshul la mngon rtogs rgyan gyi skabs su/ slob dpon ha ri bha dras gzhan du bkral kyang*/ 'phags pa thogs med zhabs kyis rgyud bla ma'i ṭikkār/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po de gang zhe na/ zhes dris pa'i lan du/ 'di las bsal bya ci yang med// ces sogs kyi tshigs bcad dang*/ de'i don gsal bar byed pa la/ rnam dbyer bcas pa'i mtshan nyid can// glo bur dag gis khams stong gi /rnam dbyer med pa'i mtshan nyid can// bla med chos kyis stong ma yin// zhes bkod nas/ 'dis ci bstan zhe na/ gang gi phyir rang bzhin gyis yongs su dag pa de bzhin gshegs pa'i khams 'di las bsal bar bya ba kun nas nyon mongs pa'i rgyu mtshan ni 'ga' yang med de glo bur ba'i dri ma dang bral ba ni 'di'i rang bzhin yin pa'i phyir ro// 'di la rnam par byang ba'i rgyu mtshan bzhag par bya ba cung zad kyang yod pa ma yin te rnam par dbye ba med pa'i chos dag pa'i chos nyid ni 'di'i rang bzhin yin pa'i phyir ro// zhes sogs dang*/ dag dang nyon mongs mi ldan phyir// kun nas nyon mongs med dag phyir// rnam par dbye ba med chos phyir// lhun grub rnam par mi rtog phyir// zhes dang*/ de'i 'grel par/ de la dri ma med pa'i sangs rgyas kyi yon tan ni/ gcig tu kun nas nyon mongs pa so so skye bo'i sa la yang rnam par dbye ba med pa'i chos nyid snga phyi khyad par med pa yod pa'i phyir gnas 'di bsam gyis mi khyab ces sogs bshad do// ma rtogs pa'i dus kyi 'ching byed gang yin pa de nyid rtogs pa'i dus su grol bar byed pa'i lam yin pas/

tha dad du bzung ba'i spang blang 'dir mi bya zhes ston pa la/ mda' bsnun zhabs kyis/ gang zhig 'ching ba de yis grol// zhes dang*/ 'khor ba gang de mya ngan 'das par nges// zhes sogs gsungs pas thugs khog cher mdzad du gsol/ gzhan yang*/ rnam par bzhag pa 'di la log rtog gi mun pa lnga bsal bar bya ste/ gang zhe na/ lta ba'i skabs su nyon mongs spang bya dang*/ dkar phyogs blang byar 'dod pa ni yul la log par rtog pa ste/ de dgag pa la/ dmangs do har/ gang zhig gang la mos par gyur pa des// bsam gtan gnas pas thar pa thob bam ci// mar me ci dgos lha bshos de ci dgos// de la gsang sngags bsten pa ci zhig dgos// zhes dang*/ lha la mchod pa khri phrag phul byas kyang*// de yis bdag nyid 'ching 'gyur ci zhig bya// de 'dras 'khor ba 'di ni 'chad min te// gnyug ma'i rang bzhin ma rtogs brgal mi nus// zhes dang*/ chos dang chos min mnyes nas zos pa yis// 'di la nyes pa rdul tsam yod ma yin// zhes pa'i 'grel par/ slob dpon thar pa 'byung gnas sbas pas/ de la chos ni dge ba'o// chos min ni mi dge ba'o// mnyes pa ni khyad par med par ro// zos pa ni rtogs pa'o// de ltar de ni las rgyu 'bras bral ba'o// zhes sogs gsungs pa 'di ni/ kye rdo rjer/ sngags kyi bzlas med dka' thub med cing sbyin bsreg med// dkyil 'khor can yang med cing dkyil 'khor yang ni med// ces pa dang mthun pa nyid do// de lta bu'i lung yang lta ba'i yin lugs ston pa'i skabs su 'dren gyi gzhan du ma yin pas/ nga'i bla ma sa paṇa gyis/ dper na phyag dang mchod pa dang*// sbyin dang tshul khrims sogs mi dgos// sems bskyed dbang bskur bya mi dgos// bsam gtan klog pa 'dir mi dgos// dge dang sdig pa gnyis ka med// sangs rgyas sems can yod min sogs// 'di 'dra gsungs pa'i lung rnams kun// lta ba'i yin gyi sgom pa dang*// spyod pa gnyis kyi lung ma yin// zhes gsungs pa ltar ro// bskal pa grangs med sogs yun ring pos bgrod par 'dod pa ni dus la log par rtog pa ste/

de dgag pa la mtshan brjod las/ dus gsum dus med rtogs pa po// zhes pa'i 'grel par slob dpon nyi ma dpal ye shes kyis/ chos kyi dbyings mi zad pas/ 'das pa dang*/ ma 'ongs pa dang*/ da ltar byung ba'i dus rnams su gnas pa dang bral ba'i phyir dus gsum dus med rtogs par gnas pa'o// zhes pa'i don go na log rtog de 'gag go /sems las gzhan pa'i ye shes 'dod pa ni ngo bo la log par rtogs pa ste/ de dgag pa la mdo sde rgyan las/ me long ye shes nga nyid med// yongs su ma chad rtag tu ldan// shes bya kun la ma rmongs la// rtag tu de la mngon phyogs min// zhes pa nas/ bsam gyis mi khyab shes par bya// zhes pa'i bar gyis kun gzhi'i ngo bo me long lta bu/ nyon yid kyi ngo bo mnyam nyid/ yid kyi ngo bo sor rtog sgo lnga'i shes pa'i ngo bo bya grub/ thams cad kyi khyab byed chos dbyings ye shes te rang sems 'di ka rgyal ba'i ye shes mtha' dag gi don du shes par bya'o// des sems ma dag pa dang ye shes dag par bsams nas tha dad du 'dzin pa bsal nas gdod ma'i ye shes mngon du byas nas rnam par grol bar bstan no// sems can las gzhan pa'i sangs rgyas 'dod pa rang bzhin la log par rtog pa ste/ de dgag pa la 'phags pa dad pa'i stobs bskyed pa la 'jug pa'i phyag rgya zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo las/ bdag ni ye shes kyis nyon mongs pa rnams gzhom pa yang ma yin/ ye shes kyis nyon mongs pa rnams mi gzhom pa yang ma yin no// zhes bya ba la zhugs kyi/ gzhan dag kyang ye shes kyis nyon mongs pa rnams gzhom pa ma yin/ ye shes kyis nyon mongs pa rnams mi gzhom pa yang ma yin no// zhes bya ba la gzud do// zhes dbugs 'byin pa rnyed par 'gyur ro// de ci'i phyir zhe na/ nyon mongs pa'i rang bzhin las ye shes gzhan ma yin pa'i phyir te/ nyon mongs pa'i rang bzhin las ye shes gzhan med pas/
